subject: Tim Walz' Shocking Lie to Us
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=1)
---
Peter \-- You and I have not forgetten what Tim Walz did to us during COVID. He locked us in our homes, put COVID positive people in nursing homes, shut down small businesses, mandated masks, closed down churches and **took children out of schools**. But when asked by the media about the school closures - which are having a real negative impact on our young children - he told his BIGGEST LIE yet. **[Walz told a reporter](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRar3fjw1Z-YlomXccLKFakX&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=2) that "80% of Minnesota kids missed fewer than 10 days in the classroom."**
## LIAR!
That statement is so ridiculously false, that it's insulting. And as you can probably guess, the media isn't doing their job to tell the truth. They are providing cover for Tim Walz. **We discuss this story and the new revelations about COVID mandates on our show today. Give it a watch:** [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRa9b0tGoEsB7IGghnCL4yK_&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=3)
## [WATCH NOW](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRa9b0tGoEsB7IGghnCL4yK_&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=4)
You and I both already know that Tim Walz struggles with the truth. And we both remember what he did during COVID. But will the masses of voters in Minnesota remember that on Election Day?! It's our job at Action 4 Liberty to remind Minnesota voters of the true record of Tim Walz. We have the most extensive grassroots operations in the state of Minnesota. And we have the record of success to show for it. Last summer, we forced the Legislature to End Walz' Emergency Powers - right at the most critical time... **Remember, in August of 2022, Politicians from Joe Biden down to Jacob Frey were starting to institute vaccine mandates. But Walz no longer had the power to do it.** That's because we forced politicians in St Paul to End Walz' Emergency Powers by launching over 50,000 phone calls, knocking on 40,000 doors and getting our message to hundreds of thousands of Minnesota voters through digital marketing. Our effectiveness is second to none! When you don't have multi-million dollar budgets like Special Interest groups, you have to go directly to the People with your message - which we LOVE to do! Well that mission continues over the next couple months as we approach the November election. Voters will be reminded of Walz' failures over and over again because of our ability to get to the voters. I'm incredibly optimistic that our message is resonating. Just look at the popularity of our "Dump Walz" State Fair booth. [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=5) The energy and popularity surrounding our "Dump Walz" message means something good for Minnesotans. **But there is a lot of work still to do. So we won't rest now because setting the record straight about Walz' true record is too damn important.** Stay tuned for more information on how you can help in this important fight! **In Liberty,** **** **Jake Duesenberg** **President, Action 4 Liberty** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=6 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tim_walz_shocking_lie_to_us&n=6)

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Colleges are teaching Black people to hate America
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61170892:6Ty4NVVNR:m:1:3253819041:94E2BBA6CDC800773CA44F41A10775AF:r)

Peter,

Radical professors and the media want us divided.

Hatred is something taught to people. And it's a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves as victims.
* The media spreads lies about criminals like George Floyd to inflame racial tensions.
* CRT teaches us to divide the world by skin color.
* Worst of them all, colleges teach Black students to see themselves as oppressed.

But in this country, _we are not divided_. It's all a myth -- just a figment of someone's sick imagination.

You can be whatever you want to pursue. You can accomplish anything with enough passion, honor, and integrity. **There is no other country in the whole world where Black people prosper as much as they do here. **

But young people are confused and convinced that they have barriers in place that do not exist.

We have to change the way we perceive ourselves.

**That 's why I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens**. We are changing the narrative as we seek to abolish the victim mentality.

And I have great news to share with you...

**This fall, the BLEXIT Student Movement is launching its first official club at the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, a historically Black college.**

[_**Peter, can you help me create more BLEXIT student clubs in historically Black colleges? Click here to donate $25, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61170892:6Ty4NVVNR:m:1:3253819041:94E2BBA6CDC800773CA44F41A10775AF:r)

We're starting a new initiative to reach college students, the BLEXIT Student Movement clubs.

These clubs bring BLEXIT's five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts on their campus, especially in historically Black colleges.
1. **Advocating** for School Choice.
2. **Promoting** criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities.
3. **Championing** entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
4. **Developing** history programs that will inspire minority children.
5. **Presenting** the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

These clubs also go to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality.

BLEXIT is helping Black and minority communities exit the victimhood mentality by changing the way we see ourselves. Will you support BLEXIT's mission by donating today?

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61170892:6Ty4NVVNR:m:1:3253819041:94E2BBA6CDC800773CA44F41A10775AF:r)

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**WHAT IS BLEXIT?**

People ask me all the time - what does BLEXIT mean?

It's an exit from the vicious cycle of victimhood mentality promoted by the media and colleges.

They teach us to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

**Victimhood is a mental virus that infects our Black and minority communities. We need to eradicate it. **

BLEXIT is getting Black and urban communities to EXIT the victimhood and become victors. What are victors? Individuals who can think for themselves and promote a healthy community of Faith, Freedom, and Family.

We are looking to open another club in a historically Black college this semester. But it can be difficult...

**Candace and I have a goal of raising $5,000 (that 's $2,500 per Student Movement club) to get our start this upcoming semester. **

But for every additional $2,500 raised, you make it possible for us to open a new Student Movement club during the school year.

Peter, can you donate to BLEXIT today? Your gift will help us empower Black communities and abolish the narrative of the victimhood mentality.

And it's a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves as victims. The media spreads lies about criminals like George Floyd to inflame racial tensions. CRT teaches us to divide the world by skin color. Worst of them all, colleges teach Black students to see themselves as oppressed. But in this country, we are not divided. It's all a myth -- just a figment of someone's sick imagination. You can be whatever you want to pursue. You can accomplish anything with enough passion, honor, and integrity. There is no other country in the whole world where Black people prosper as much as they do here. But young people are confused and convinced that they have barriers in place that do not exist. We have to change the way we perceive ourselves. That 's why I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. We are changing the narrative as we seek to abolish the victim mentality. And I have great news to share with you... This fall, the BLEXIT Student Movement is launching its first official club at the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, a historically Black college. We're starting a new initiative to reach college students, the BLEXIT Student Movement clubs. These clubs bring BLEXIT's five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts on their campus, especially in historically Black colleges. 1. Advocating for School Choice. 2. Promoting criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities. 3. Championing entrepreneurship and free enterprise. 4. Developing history programs that will inspire minority children. 5. Presenting the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences. These clubs also go to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality. BLEXIT is helping Black and minority communities exit the victimhood mentality by changing the way we see ourselves. Will you support BLEXIT's mission by donating today? Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Colleges are teaching Black people to hate America
body:
Hatred is something taught to people. And it’s a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves a
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zr33bld6f00iqui7kgbf44en9garcnoqciifdb0g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ei3bd9ieir38cth6kpjactmekpradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfbcbjc9qnbdbgserb8cjncpo65c3mm8orao5jmthr8srh61pjbcpkc8ob2pjkesrt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9p6cc5kmdj3fdj2coq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdhm4p34cpg64o324no)
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlq94i5v3lt059m1ecjhuba5s1ukvmm8drus5h18_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi6co32c1h2bs)

Friend,

Radical professors and the media want us divided.

Hatred is something taught to people. And it's a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves as victims.
* The media spreads lies about criminals like George Floyd to inflame racial tensions.
* CRT teaches us to divide the world by skin color.
* Worst of them all, colleges teach Black students to see themselves as oppressed.

But in this country, _we are not divided_. It's all a myth -- just a figment of someone's sick imagination.

You can be whatever you want to pursue. You can accomplish anything with enough passion, honor, and integrity. **There is no other country in the whole world where Black people prosper as much as they do here. **

But young people are confused and convinced that they have barriers in place that do not exist.

We have to change the way we perceive ourselves.

**That 's why I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens**. We are changing the narrative as we seek to abolish the victim mentality.

And I have great news to share with you...

**This fall, the BLEXIT Student Movement is launching its first official club at the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, a historically Black college.**

[_**Friend, can you help me create more BLEXIT student clubs in historically Black colleges? Click here to donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjbgvr9ravkf7r0qmamb2tb9ajvoth5prbgbq3fo_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi6co32c1h2bs)

We're starting a new initiative to reach college students, the BLEXIT Student Movement clubs.

These clubs bring BLEXIT's five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts on their campus, especially in historically Black colleges.
1. **Advocating** for School Choice.
2. **Promoting** criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities.
3. **Championing** entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
4. **Developing** history programs that will inspire minority children.
5. **Presenting** the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

These clubs also go to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality.

BLEXIT is helping Black and minority communities exit the victimhood mentality by changing the way we see ourselves. Will you support BLEXIT's mission by donating today?

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpsp8krmkh0ioc5u7u8ocaoq5rr84pca2imr13l0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi6co32c1h2bs)

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**WHAT IS BLEXIT?**

People ask me all the time - what does BLEXIT mean?

It's an exit from the vicious cycle of victimhood mentality promoted by the media and colleges.

They teach us to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

**Victimhood is a mental virus that infects our Black and minority communities. We need to eradicate it. **

BLEXIT is getting Black and urban communities to EXIT the victimhood and become victors. What are victors? Individuals who can think for themselves and promote a healthy community of Faith, Freedom, and Family.

We are looking to open another club in a historically Black college this semester. But it can be difficult...

**Candace and I have a goal of raising $5,000 (that 's $2,500 per Student Movement club) to get our start this upcoming semester. **

But for every additional $2,500 raised, you make it possible for us to open a new Student Movement club during the school year.

Friend, can you donate to BLEXIT today? Your gift will help us empower Black communities and abolish the narrative of the victimhood mentality.
[**Donate $10 >>>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztvf0ccv8jsaj7t259hirehskb7jm8r1tksqf9go_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi6co32c1h2bs)

[**Donate $250 >>>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zve98tgm2da7srg76c7gcvv27e42660npoqfg1go_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi6co32c1h2bs)
[**Donate $500 >>>**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkoh9v0sld6nikhcrf790qiltsgfbr0vu7d46na8_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi6co32c1h2bs)

body:
You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4tgsht9i9jsfpu2o55tu9a9puhjoq3hp0lj73c8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tpme6pbct75mqpjddj4ehg79pr2c2qe4thjmhp6cdj5e9q7apjke8pbcc3kepoefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup74phgmipm2ptnctj32s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6oj4chh61pr7c8iv0)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here's how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. It will go directly towards YAL 's work to fight for laws that advance liberty, train students to become door knockers before the 2022 elections, and so much more. I am asking for your immediate support now to get 1,000 students mobilized for freedom. **

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4jt9qe4bldo1hgh6ibb83dq0ccg9iu9occr2u88_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o77cth2bs)

[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zelou06cfnhp4i10ipbj7q3pc7141upfclgu4fb0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o77cth2bs)
[_**Donate $210 to sponsor a student >>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z430or74n3lmel49s89j06samarkq4u7e2bthb40_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o77cth2bs)
[_**Donate $420 to sponsor two students >>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zttlrbn4c3v459a2nirajr896rvloa94rm9g0l4g_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o77cth2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8726mlqvg4vbt7rl6bp64qmvoigno4m27alvvu8_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o77cth2bs)

Here's how it works.

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>
> **Next:** YAL takes the top student leaders and brings them to top notch trainings. There, students are taught how to transform their campus and fight for liberty candidates and causes in the legislature.
>
> **Then:** Thousands of student activists recruited and trained by YAL knock on doors to push liberty legislation, and turn out the vote for liberty-minded candidates running for office.
>
> **Finally:** These liberty legislators pass bills to defend freedom of speech, protect the 2nd Amendment, and expand free markets.

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

All of this hinges on training the next generation of liberty patriots.

Can you join me today to help YAL defend our liberty and train the next generation of liberty activists? Click below to send your urgent support.

[_**Donate $100 >>**_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbb187lo3rma2ckoglt9m09ls2j0sbummsqgo70g_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o77cth2bs)

body:

---
Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change.
**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171719:JKFF8VVZN:m:1:3317145305:E0CB57D719B168244E59C6B96969E5A2:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171719:JKFF8VVZN:m:1:3317145305:E0CB57D719B168244E59C6B96969E5A2:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171719:JKFF8VVZN:m:1:3317145305:E0CB57D719B168244E59C6B96969E5A2:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you're able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171719:JKFF8VVZN:m:1:3317145305:E0CB57D719B168244E59C6B96969E5A2:r)** | [**DONATE $500**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171720:JKFF8VVZN:m:1:3317145305:E0CB57D719B168244E59C6B96969E5A2:r)

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z99vjhk573s78qjeaa6povgpfl2cekk033vbvfgo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq7bctimlrb4clkc4obcs34msrj5d5jmsrbeob4maoe4ddncphm3dj36dp37c776v970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6ptie9j31d5jc5jrepj664ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933cdh68p32c3hm6oh5u)

---|---
Dear Friend, Today's social studies and American history textbooks aren't cutting it. We've read them all, and what we've discovered is staggering. Most kids' history textbooks focus on superficial facts and gloss over the Founding Fathers' ideas that revolutionized America and the world.

Even worse, they don't help young readers understand why what happened 250 years ago is still relevant to our world today.

That's why the Libertas Institute launched a 240-page American history textbook that uses stories to share the inspiring ideas and powerful principles that our country was founded on. It's designed to help the rising generation connect the dots to see how lessons learned from the past can still be applied today.
**[You can see for yourself by taking a peek inside at a free chapter using this link. ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmitpi6on9cp7p1trrr6in70nes2hr6s59frgi9o_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o73cdh2bs)**

Right now kids across the country are heading back to school. And more will be going back in the coming weeks. It is critical that we get this book into our schools immediately.

**[And I'm really hoping I can count on your help.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmm9rhu66gifnq55hvjo40e6n1r9de8t330opvl0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o73cdh2bs)**
Today, a tax-deductible gift of $100 will:
* Ensure that at least 10,000 students will learn from this book within the next year.
* Support teachers who want to teach true history and are frustrated by having to use "Common Core," Critical Race Theory, and more.
* Fund and employ a person on our team whose sole full-time job is to get this history book--and its curriculum--into schools across the country.

You can make your gift using this secure link:

**[https://secure.anedot.com/libertas-institute/back-to-school](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zolgena6t7ee08ln3sm1araa8aldk7bi4k14m7vg_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o73cdh2bs)**

But please don't wait.

These kids will reach voting age before we know it. And if we don't teach them the truth about American history, they will grow up to support policies and politicians that are at odds with freedom and America's founding.

We can't let that happen.

That's why we must work fast to get this textbook into our schools as students head back to class.

Please make your very best gift right now to help teach kids the truth about American history using this secure link:

**[https://secure.anedot.com/libertas-institute/back-to-school](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z85ja88uievlau61d5brgklu00ac89c1uaib1vt0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chi64o73cdh2bs)**

Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change.
**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171830:6qgOkVV2N:m:1:3331421248:E480C1CD3A42A47ABB853422690A5A14:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171830:6qgOkVV2N:m:1:3331421248:E480C1CD3A42A47ABB853422690A5A14:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171830:6qgOkVV2N:m:1:3331421248:E480C1CD3A42A47ABB853422690A5A14:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. A recent Hillsdale College seminar considered the idea of the Great Reset, its ramifications for America, and pro-freedom alternatives. **This seminar --titled [“The Great Reset?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75023%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4PiTewIC4HqOUq9EFrbJ1Q&sysid=1)****[”](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75024%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TXW32hBIATqFEhrnv3v9CQ&sysid=1)[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75022%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=axlvRwIskUQAqMS2zZcO%2bA&sysid=1)--is now available as a free online video series.**

* The origins and leaders of the Great Reset

* What “environmental justice” has to do with the Great Reset
* The Great Reset from China’s perspective

Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change.
**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171869:6q6npVVtN:m:1:3253819041:577820F6FB94B2FF112A9EC72474729B:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171869:6q6npVVtN:m:1:3253819041:577820F6FB94B2FF112A9EC72474729B:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171869:6q6npVVtN:m:1:3253819041:577820F6FB94B2FF112A9EC72474729B:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you're able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171869:6q6npVVtN:m:1:3253819041:577820F6FB94B2FF112A9EC72474729B:r)** | [**DONATE $500**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61171870:6q6npVVtN:m:1:3253819041:577820F6FB94B2FF112A9EC72474729B:r)

Hello,
Well, it didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.

Early bird ticket prices will expire at midnight, and I want you to save money – [get your tickets and hear from Mike Pompeo TODAY](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=1187419.429.1.70bacd594ffe9fdd234239ac9b24eaca)! But this is simply not true. DOJ is investigating scores of attacks on pro-life pregnancy clinics. Not a single arrest has been made. But when a Planned Parenthood clinic was attacked, they made an arrest in 4 days. 2) The woke police need to keep their hands off our military. It is more important than ever to support America's parents and not let woke teachers indoctrinate America's kids. 4) Higher education is a massive industry devoted to progressive politics. This isn't student loan forgiveness; it's another big Biden giveaway to special interests. And you get to pay for it. 5) Progressives want to replace police officers with social workers. They want to replace 1776 with 1619. They want to replace the American dream with government handouts. We won’t let them. 6) Millions of Americans are still hurting horribly from inflation caused by 18 months of Biden policies, all while the White House and mainstream media try to spin it as an economic success. If you think that's just for the billionaires, think again. 8) The federal government does not make the American Dream possible. It gets in the way. Less government = more freedom and opportunity. 9) Everywhere you turn today, the Progressive Left wants to force their deeply twisted ideas about morality, faith, and values on America. Don’t let them. 10) The American Dream birthed the greatest nation known to man. Instead of apologizing, we should be celebrating and fighting for America. The United FRONTLINE Gala is the can’t miss event of the year. I promise you will be inspired by our message, encouraged, and blessed to hear from Mike Pompeo. Cole

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Mary Peltola’s special election victory filled us with hope this week, but she has to do it all over again this November, in the general election. It’s coming up fast, and she needs our help to defend this amazing win!
body:
You helped her keep Sarah Palin out of Congress!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter _**,**_ we LOVE this! She. Did. It. Mary Peltola, a seasoned state legislator and proven campaigner, BEAT Sarah Palin in an incredible upset in this week’s special election. We told you we believed this great candidate could become the first Alaska Native to win an election to Congress, and she did it!! **Peltola's great campaign--including steadfast support for a women's right to choose, fighting to protect Alaska's natural resources and standing up for Alaskan workers--got it done by 3%, 51.5%-48.5%. The toxic, nasty, right wing zealotry of Palin was also helpful in sealing her fate.** So we have good news and bad news. The bad news is that this was a special election for the seat left open when Rep. Don Young passed away, and there will be a repeat in November. The good news, we have an extra Democratic seat in Congress for those few months, Peltola will be an incumbent when she runs in November and she'll benefit from taking on the toxic Palin yet again.
---

body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61174069:6TlOyVVN3:m:1:3253819041:5DAB56A810BFC5DDF6720EDE262C0012:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

Dear Fellow Conservative, I'm writing to you today because something has been troubling me, and I'd like to know if it's troubling you. The Supreme Court's landmark decision reversing the legal abomination that was _Roe v. Wade_ was a monumental step to protecting life. But I'm concerned that too many conservatives think this victory means the fight for life has already been won, and that as a result, complacency will set in. **Because the truth is, this fight is far from over.** The radical Left knows this, and they're _counting_ on the pro-life movement to let down our guard. They're racing to codify pro-abortion laws at both the state and federal levels. And unless something is done, they won't stop until they've achieved unrestricted abortion on-demand. **We can 't allow this to happen.** Right now, the policy landscape across all levels of government is ripe with opportunities to seize this hard-fought momentum and further protect the unborn from the Left's insidious attempt to dismantle the American family. This is why we're seeking your help as we now focus our efforts on revitalizing a culture of life at every level of government. Because the laws in each state vary, we have a lot of work to do. And today I'd like to invite you to stand with us in protecting those who cannot protect themselves. Complacency isn't an option. We must stop the radical Left's attempt to unravel the American family, and we must do it today. **Will you join the fight to protect the unborn with your generous gift today?** If you're ready to fight for the unborn and help rebuild a culture of life throughout America, make your tax-deductible gift using this secure link now: **[https://secured.heritage.org/fight-for-life-donate/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=a8a1c8bb41344fe7a4d4de457d1801bd&_e=2cY82ETnmvWFFNhy037m94giuCGCkQhIUHX-dw513zBPW_bSxGuZn0u3Ui0t03aEXYhGzwd1rbxyPQHXadnYM2GSv2bFSs2Ylou5jj2lnXjD0nf3x-nv_aoBCwaZ_JLQ-3e5XY_aAq7o8M1uH448uZu2eDWMYx6C4tVMoZmhvT60Vg69iWw9Js-9SF-PLwHSEj0azeD4wjbm1Dkt6dov9kNqG6I39tz7rH_TPmvTsHtWm2KrbSemvTSPD4-aORvAR2hdD2VjNzvHSf8SMnofFHT1N8VWiy8VInoJKKB_rN_gsorhwG_anJZbZyrZ1cypYCSYKK6h3Bj90PTbRk-Ebu4NbhapD5KROs5uFqT9KRE%3D)** Thank you for your support. Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D. President, The Heritage Foundation **P.S. body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1qk7b0traasj2v1qf2t1l0ic1j9t3tqepotieeo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onlchp75dpn6iqn6pphclge7c30m5oj9o9hcapb0sjgc6r74ohgmkpm5c33cjieeduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9gmdgefclncoo7ecr4cuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66or2chh6epj0c3h2bs)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1flprl675fsjph02pqosv0hahq83cvm9vhe26f0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chh6epj0c3h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |
* * *
A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zkim52fifqkmvcivrahre8qv07v6ko4363g03b0g_rp22sh2s8i66or2chh6epj0c3h2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

subject: We asked how student debt cancellation will affect this team. Here’s what you said:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren Democrats
body:
Sharing student debt stories from readers like you. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50127470/364731894/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ7Y_STU_T_20220902_V1S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzBiNDRmMi1jNjJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u9IFpua6VfNLMnVJGVyTLkAFgVp40A7Ai4DqfDBrZFE=&emci=1442a7eb-c62a-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=e30b44f2-c62a-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=9027908)
---
After President Biden announced his plan to cancel up to $20,000 of student debt for eligible borrowers, we asked this team how this policy will affect them. Readers like you sent in a wide range of answers — and we wanted to share a few of them with you below:
* * *
“**As a Pell Grant receiver, this new student debt cancellation plan will hopefully clear me of my public student loans!** I hope to see more action taken for those who are further buried in debt, as well as action to decrease the cost of college and control the loan interest rates.”
* * *
“I was raised with the idealism that if you ‘Do everything right, go to college and get a degree, the world is your oyster!’ and I did just that. Went to undergraduate school in-state, and worked as a special education teacher (Emotional and Behavioral Support for K-4th grade) and tried for years to get a position at a good school district. I made $29k a year and was $35k in Student Loan debt. I went on to get my Master’s and many certifications in Education to hopefully land the district job I’d always dreamed of having. I taught for 11 years, and barely put a dent in my loans. I didn’t have a supportive family, and was trying to do life on my own. I had a baby, got married and we wanted to buy a house but I didn’t qualify to be on the mortgage because of the Student Loans (despite my husband being a Veteran!) **With this relief and the PSLF, I’ll get a second lease on life at 37 and not feel completely hindered and stunted by these loans. I want to save up money for our daughter’s future education, and now I feel we can finally do that.** I never want her to have to take out loans to pay for school for the promise of a better future! I feel an incredible weight lifted, and that we can really begin to move forward and make progress.”
* * *
“I've been paying on my student loans since 2007. I've never missed a payment. But because I have been on an income dependent repayment plan, I've never paid more than the interest. The principal hasn't gone down. I've worked in the nonprofit sector since graduating, and haven't made a lot of money. I didn't qualify for the public servant forgiveness because my specific loan type was discontinued by the government and not included in that program — a technicality. **I cried when I read the news. My entire balance will be forgiven.** ”
* * *
“I have $80k in student debt. I am 45 years old. I am an adjunct professor at Massachusetts College of Art and Boston College. I did have Pell grants so I assume I will have 1/4 of my student debt erased. The change this makes for me is that I now see it as a possibility that my student debt will not outlive me. I don’t see it as a strong possibility, just a possibility. Before this relief I did not see any possibility that I would outlive my student debt. It’s a good start. I look forward to future solutions that make higher ed affordable for all.”
* * *
“My husband and I will have 2/3 of our loans forgiven (we're in our early 40s) and have a plan to pay off the rest by the end of this year. Thank you for pushing on this! We are able to breathe lighter.”
* * *
“I paid off my student debt almost a decade ago. That was the benefit of my education choices, federal and local scholarships, a frugal lifestyle graduating right after the '09 crash, and a fair amount of luck. But **I know many classmates, family members, and others who would benefit from this program, and having this debt forgiveness will bring them significant financial security; maybe even enough to afford a mortgage!** ”
* * *
“This will help me a lot. I owe 30,000 in student loans and I may qualify for the 20,000. If I do I can focus on saving for a house, which is something so hard to accomplish for the low income community. Thank you to everyone who fought for this. I now see a better future for my family and me.”
* * *
“This cancellation is LIFE CHANGING for both my fiancé and myself. We can now afford to look at homes and start our family planning journey. Tears of joy were shed and we are so proud to have supported this president. THANK YOU for fighting the good fight for us all”
* * *
“I was over 45 before I managed to pay off my student loans so this no longer affects me but it is a boon to my grandchildren for which I'm so grateful. Maybe they'll have an earlier start on marriage, buying a home, and having children.”
* * *
“My husband and I are 64 and 65 years old and still paying PLUS loans for our 33 year old and 26 year old kids’ undergraduate educations. I think this debt cancellation will mean our loans for our daughter are paid off, and our loans for our son are $10K less. **This will make it more possible for us to afford to retire in a year or two.** Thank you!”
* * *

clean_body: Sharing student debt stories from readers like you. | | | After President Biden announced his plan to cancel up to $20,000 of student debt for eligible borrowers, we asked this team how this policy will affect them. Readers like you sent in a wide range of answers — and we wanted to share a few of them with you below: “As a Pell Grant receiver, this new student debt cancellation plan will hopefully clear me of my public student loans! I hope to see more action taken for those who are further buried in debt, as well as action to decrease the cost of college and control the loan interest rates.” “I was raised with the idealism that if you ‘Do everything right, go to college and get a degree, the world is your oyster!’ and I did just that. Went to undergraduate school in-state, and worked as a special education teacher (Emotional and Behavioral Support for K-4th grade) and tried for years to get a position at a good school district. I made $29k a year and was $35k in Student Loan debt. I went on to get my Master’s and many certifications in Education to hopefully land the district job I’d always dreamed of having. I taught for 11 years, and barely put a dent in my loans. I didn’t have a supportive family, and was trying to do life on my own. I had a baby, got married and we wanted to buy a house but I didn’t qualify to be on the mortgage because of the Student Loans (despite my husband being a Veteran!) With this relief and the PSLF, I’ll get a second lease on life at 37 and not feel completely hindered and stunted by these loans. I want to save up money for our daughter’s future education, and now I feel we can finally do that. I never want her to have to take out loans to pay for school for the promise of a better future! I feel an incredible weight lifted, and that we can really begin to move forward and make progress.” “I've been paying on my student loans since 2007. I've never missed a payment. But because I have been on an income dependent repayment plan, I've never paid more than the interest. The principal hasn't gone down. I've worked in the nonprofit sector since graduating, and haven't made a lot of money. I didn't qualify for the public servant forgiveness because my specific loan type was discontinued by the government and not included in that program — a technicality. I cried when I read the news. My entire balance will be forgiven. ” “I have $80k in student debt. I am 45 years old. I am an adjunct professor at Massachusetts College of Art and Boston College. I did have Pell grants so I assume I will have 1/4 of my student debt erased. The change this makes for me is that I now see it as a possibility that my student debt will not outlive me. I don’t see it as a strong possibility, just a possibility. Before this relief I did not see any possibility that I would outlive my student debt. It’s a good start. I look forward to future solutions that make higher ed affordable for all.” “My husband and I will have 2/3 of our loans forgiven (we're in our early 40s) and have a plan to pay off the rest by the end of this year. Thank you for pushing on this! We are able to breathe lighter.” “I paid off my student debt almost a decade ago. That was the benefit of my education choices, federal and local scholarships, a frugal lifestyle graduating right after the '09 crash, and a fair amount of luck. When you win by the tightest margin of any sitting Senator as I did, you understand that every single factor – and every single dollar – has the power to tip the outcome of a race. **[Even just $3 has the potential to make a real impact in a race this tight. I know that from experience.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50133959/364755966/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1565-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTRkZWZlOC1jZjJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-o5wESJgMiUx3Q5zvbYmV9KkFsqESb2cBvmGL9dILMo=)**
In 2016 I beat the Republican incumbent by just 1,017 votes, winning one of the closest Senate races in history.
I talk about those 1,017 votes a lot. And they _are_ incredibly important – without those votes, Democrats wouldn’t have the Senate majority – but today, I’m reaching out to tell you about what preceded those votes.
I’m talking about the hard work that we did to get across the finish line on Nov. 8, 2016. Because it wasn’t just 1,017 votes that sent me to the Senate: It was **354,649**. And we had to work for every single one.
To earn those hundreds of thousands of votes, we put ads on the air to reach voters across the state, built a strong ground game, and knocked hundreds of thousands of doors.
We were able to do all that thanks to support from grassroots donors like you, friend, who gave us the resources to build the strongest campaign possible. And in a race that came down to just 0.14%, every dollar raised and every door knocked made all the difference in beating the odds and winning in 2016.
Now, Election Day 2022 is almost upon us, and we can’t let up. To win in November, we are really going to have to put the pedal to the metal from here on out.
**And that takes resources.**
We’ll need that same army of grassroots supporters to help us. **[That’s why I’m coming to you today, team, to ask you to contribute $3, or whatever you can, to this campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50133960/364755967/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1565-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTRkZWZlOC1jZjJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-o5wESJgMiUx3Q5zvbYmV9KkFsqESb2cBvmGL9dILMo=)**
The stakes couldn’t be higher. If we lose in New Hampshire, we’ll hand Mitch McConnell the majority on a silver platter. But if we all pull together — as we did the last time that we bucked national trends — we can defeat the GOP and deny McConnell the gavel.
**[We simply can’t afford to lose, that’s why I have to ask: Can you help us keep going?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50133961/364755968/-1829049351?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1565-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNTRkZWZlOC1jZjJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-o5wESJgMiUx3Q5zvbYmV9KkFsqESb2cBvmGL9dILMo=)**
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

And they are incredibly important – without those votes, Democrats wouldn’t have the Senate majority – but today, I’m reaching out to tell you about what preceded those votes. I’m talking about the hard work that we did to get across the finish line on Nov. 8, 2016. Because it wasn’t just 1,017 votes that sent me to the Senate: It was 354,649. And we had to work for every single one. To earn those hundreds of thousands of votes, we put ads on the air to reach voters across the state, built a strong ground game, and knocked hundreds of thousands of doors. We were able to do all that thanks to support from grassroots donors like you, friend, who gave us the resources to build the strongest campaign possible. And in a race that came down to just 0.14%, every dollar raised and every door knocked made all the difference in beating the odds and winning in 2016. Now, Election Day 2022 is almost upon us, and we can’t let up. To win in November, we are really going to have to put the pedal to the metal from here on out. And that takes resources. We’ll need that same army of grassroots supporters to help us. = The stakes couldn’t be higher. If we lose in New Hampshire, we’ll hand Mitch McConnell the majority on a silver platter. | ,
Today I have an urgent message regarding Californian’s safety -[ **we have to act on this now.**](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=aa9e4aa258&e=f9133ea432)

Under Newsom we’ve seen more and more bills being signed into law that are soft on crime, and favor the early release of criminals.

And now another horrible bill is being pushed through: AB 2167, allowing judges to seek softer punishments for criminals..

Instead of keeping violent criminals behind bars, bills like AB 2167 ‘soften’ the penalties for criminals.

Even Prop 57 **allows** for **raping an unconscious woman, and it is not a violent crime.**

Even **sex trafficking a woman is not a violent crime. **

As a Californian, you deserve to be kept safe.
---
| [SIGN OUR PROTEST AGAINST THIS OUTRAGEOUS BILL](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=ddb60fad99&e=f9133ea432 "SIGN OUR PROTEST AGAINST THIS OUTRAGEOUS BILL")
---
| We know that bills like this don’t work.

In fact they wreak havoc on our state.

It was just a few months ago that a violent criminal went on a shooting spree in downtown Sacramento on K street, killing 6 and putting bullet holes in the building my own son works in.

How much more do we have to endure as Californians?

What about the victims?

What about the 6 lives that were lost on K street?

Those lives wouldn’t have been lost if those criminals were serving their time.
---
| [SIGN THIS TO STOP THESE SENSELESS CRIMES](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=85b61673ee&e=f9133ea432 "SIGN THIS TO STOP THESE SENSELESS CRIMES")
---
| We have to ensure dangerous criminals serve their time instead of being released into our communities.

And when I’m governor, I will not tolerate this lawlessness.

Californians should not have to suffer.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

And, I’m close to reaching 200 endorsements from Oregon leaders and incredible grassroots organizations. We need ALL this energy and teamwork to win in November. Plus, we're seeing attack ads against me on TV. (It’s ok, though – after my time in Salem, I know how to take a punch.) name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: why you can count on me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
My dad always taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.”
| | |
---
Peter, it's Trudy Busch Valentine, your Democratic nominee for Missouri's U.S. Senate seat. I'm about to ask you to [**chip in a donation to help me flip this seat blue.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50138591/364775771/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk237-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDZjNzAwMS1kOTJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8U5P9KqvA0MrAaFdxlV0ERYLMZ-x_sH6Ht0UHUT8a0k=) **But first, could you let me explain why I'm in this race – and why you can count on me to deliver real change in Washington?**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50138593/364775773/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk237-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDZjNzAwMS1kOTJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8U5P9KqvA0MrAaFdxlV0ERYLMZ-x_sH6Ht0UHUT8a0k=)
**Growing up, I watched my dad run our family's business, one that has been based in Missouri for generations.** That business made it possible for my parents and our family to live the American Dream.
At the same time, the thousands of union workers he had the privilege to work with went home with fair wages that helped them build their own families' futures and achieve their very own American Dreams. I'm proud to say that my family's success story is also a success story for all of St. Louis and Missouri.
I could've made my family's company my life. **But my dad always taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.”** So I began volunteering at our local hospital as a candy striper. That's when I fell in love with nursing and helping others when they needed it the most.
**I achieved my dream of completing nursing school and then went on to proudly serve my community working with abused and neglected children and people in hospice.** When COVID-19 turned our world upside down and took so many loved ones away from us, I answered the call to service again by administering vaccines that finally provided some security and safety after months of uncertainty and fear.
Now, I'm running for Senate because Washington is failing the families who I've spent my life serving. In the Senate, there's just too much political greed and not enough compassion or hard work.
**You can count on me to put families first in the Senate, because that's why I've done my entire life.** And I promise you, I will be no one's Senator but yours.
**With an open seat and real momentum to end the far-right extremism in Washington, I know that we can win this race. But I also know that I can't do this alone.[Please, if you have a little bit extra to spare tonight, can I count on you to chip in a grassroots donation to power this campaign? There's only two months until Election Day and donations like yours will make all the difference in this final stretch.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50138595/364775775/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk237-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDZjNzAwMS1kOTJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8U5P9KqvA0MrAaFdxlV0ERYLMZ-x_sH6Ht0UHUT8a0k=)**

clean_body: My dad always taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” | | | Peter, it's Trudy Busch Valentine, your Democratic nominee for Missouri's U.S. Senate seat. I'm about to ask you to = But first, could you let me explain why I'm in this race – and why you can count on me to deliver real change in Washington? = Growing up, I watched my dad run our family's business, one that has been based in Missouri for generations. That business made it possible for my parents and our family to live the American Dream. At the same time, the thousands of union workers he had the privilege to work with went home with fair wages that helped them build their own families' futures and achieve their very own American Dreams. I'm proud to say that my family's success story is also a success story for all of St. Louis and Missouri. I could've made my family's company my life. But my dad always taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” So I began volunteering at our local hospital as a candy striper. That's when I fell in love with nursing and helping others when they needed it the most. I achieved my dream of completing nursing school and then went on to proudly serve my community working with abused and neglected children and people in hospice. When COVID-19 turned our world upside down and took so many loved ones away from us, I answered the call to service again by administering vaccines that finally provided some security and safety after months of uncertainty and fear. Now, I'm running for Senate because Washington is failing the families who I've spent my life serving. In the Senate, there's just too much political greed and not enough compassion or hard work. You can count on me to put families first in the Senate, because that's why I've done my entire life. And I promise you, I will be no one's Senator but yours. With an open seat and real momentum to end the far-right extremism in Washington, I know that we can win this race. body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?"
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zspf96ofr4tjusegtkcn5amqv8jo567ntmrdq2dg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ujh64cj4moqmadbhehjbat3769qm6ob2mlqj4tbgecqjasrkedin2pb0emp72tpnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh62pm1o3imhj3applmhjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or3c9i6cob1c5ge49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfar15q55746kuoehc4f7uf2avuc8frg2943krqo_rp22sh2s8i66or2chj62ob1c3h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi4bhkv58p09r9h5aq29of9a94vd9u530gli2qqg_rp22sh2s8i66or2chj62ob1c3h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zddl2jt5e96b45cnnrcnjp2ihbore3cmubpgklro_rp22sh2s8i66or2chj62ob1c3h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of Imprimis —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below? Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... . . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. Why is this? Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to reach and teach millions has never been more urgently needed. That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. By responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education. Warm regards, Larry P. # The last couple years have been stressful for all of us, but how has it affected our kids? Gen-Zers are people ranging from 10 years old to 25 years old, and they need us NOW!! Here's what you need to know...
Do you remember being 18 years old, graduating from high school and feeling like you had the world on a string? I had not been a great student in high school so at 18 I was headed to junior college. I was reaping what I'd sown though, and I knew that if I got my act together I could shift my path. I enrolled in junior college in Clovis, California where I got straight A's and one year later I transferred to my dream college, Pepperdine University on a huge scholarship. My boyfriend (now husband) was already there and it felt like all my dreams were coming true. I had a genuine sense that I could become anything that I was willing to work for. I wanted to be talk show host, design purses, write books, be a theologian, and I REALLY wanted to be a wife and mom.

I grew up in poverty so I had to work a little harder than others in order see my dreams realized. Nothing, and I mean nothing, was going to be handed to me. I didn't feel sorry for myself though. I lived in America, the home of the free and the brave. I knew that I could dream, work my butt off, and make just about anything happen. I mean that. I felt like the American dream was real, was mine, and that the sky was the limit for me and my future. By the way, most of my dreams have come true. Will Gen-Zers be able to say the same thing about their life?

Can you imagine just getting started with your adult life right now? Can you imagine trying to determine what career path you want to take in a world where things are shifting so fast we can't keep up? Can you imagine trying to dream about your future when the economy and government seem so unstable?

I decided to sit down with 2 adorable Gen-Zers and find out exactly what it's like to be them right now. I wanted to understand their plight, but I also wanted to know how I could support them. You may watch our conversation here:

body:
I’m a proud retired Special Operations Navy Captain, Vietnamese Immigrant, and homeschooling parent of 5 running for Congress and I am asking for your support.

|
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Hung Cao.

America has given my family countless opportunities. That's why I've dedicated my entire life to serving our country.

name: Sen. Heidi Campbell
subject: Rape victims are not a “red herring”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Campbell for Congress
body:
https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
Last night, my opponent, Andy Ogles, told a news reporter said that rape and incest exceptions for abortion are “a red herring used by the left.”
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/View%20recent%20photos.jpeg]
Let me set the record straight: Survivors of sexual assault are real and they’re all around us. In fact, we know many of these crimes go unreported.
Andy Ogles may be comfortable using the government to force a woman to carry her rapist’s baby, but we know this is no place for a government mandate.
It’s insulting that he would reduce these victims to a political talking point and dismiss their trauma as a “red herring.” I’m ashamed and appalled.
Protecting a woman’s freedom to control her own future is a central focus of this campaign. But it is also vitally important for us to stand up for survivors of rape, incest, and all sexual violence.
Andy Ogles might not care about the rights of victims, but I do and I know you do, too. I’m proud to stand with survivors and, in Congress, we will win the fight to restore the rights and freedom of women in Tennessee.
The stakes of this election could not be higher. Every voter in this district needs to know where we both stand on women’s rights. Please consider chipping in today so we can stand up and say NO to Andy Ogles. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellemail]
My best,
Heidi
