Mitch McConnell’s super PAC just dropped $28 million into Ohio to try to
box me out.

I know $28 million sounds like a scary number—and don’t get me wrong, I’m
nervous—but this isn’t a knockout hit.

Let me explain: if everyone who got this email chipped in $78, we could
match that $28 million in just one day. That’s how big this grassroots
army is.

$78 is a big ask for a lot of folks—but if everyone forwards this email to
a friend they can count on to chip in, then it’d only take $39. And if
those people forward this to one of their friends too, then it would only
take about $20...you see where I’m going with this?

It really only takes $20 at a time to go head-to-head with $28 million in
dark money. That’s the power of a grassroots movement, and that’s exactly
what national Republicans are terrified of—they’re terrified of you
getting off the sidelines, folks.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20708?t=1008&amount=78&akid=5350%2E3611125%2ELXIzAk ]So today, I’m asking you to do one of three things:

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20708?t=1009&amount=78&akid=5350%2E3611125%2ELXIzAk ]Chip in $78

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20708?t=1010&amount=39&akid=5350%2E3611125%2ELXIzAk ]Chip in $39 and forward this email to a friend

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20708?t=1011&amount=20&akid=5350%2E3611125%2ELXIzAk ]Chip in $20 and forward this email to two friends

And if you’re not in a position to do any of the above, then do whatever
feels right for you. It doesn’t matter what you do, just as long as you
get in the game.

We’re in a strong position to win this race and expand our Senate
majority. If we weren’t, Republicans wouldn’t be spending $28 million to
try and stop us.

Together, we’ve got this!

—Tim Ryan

name: Giffords.org
subject: Can you please sign Giffords’ petition calling on credit card companies to block and flag suspicious gun purchases, particularly ones where individuals are purchasing large quantities of firearms and ammunition?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
The Las Vegas shooter charged $94,000 to his credit cards over the course of 12 months in order to purchase the guns and ammunition used in that mass shooting.
#

Friends -
Almost five years ago, a single shooter stationed in a Las Vegas hotel room shot and killed 60 people and injured many others in the deadliest mass shooting in modern American history.
To this day, much about the shooting and the motives is a mystery, but here’s one fact most people haven’t heard yet:
The Las Vegas shooter charged $94,000 to his credit cards over the course of 12 months in order to purchase the guns and ammunition used in that mass shooting.
That should have been a red flag.
Credit card companies have the software to block this—just like they block other suspicious activity.
But they don’t. The only thing the credit card companies are blocking is an effort to ensure they flag suspicious weapons purchases to law enforcement.
Visa, Master Card, American Express... it’s time to act:
[**Can you please sign Giffords’ petition calling on credit card companies to block and flag suspicious gun purchases, particularly ones where individuals are purchasing large quantities of firearms and ammunition?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_creditcard_pet/?source=em220902-1-15&refcode2=2406.3935704.03Lglx&akid=2406%2E3935704%2E03Lglx)

Signing this petition may seem like a small act, but it can make a big difference.
Thanks,
The team at Giffords

We want to share some personal stories with you. | | | Peter, Last week we sent an email explaining President Biden’s student debt cancellation plan and asking supporters like you to share how this cancellation will change their lives. The stories you shared with us were personal, touching, and in some cases, frustrating. We are so grateful to all who opened up to us, and, with their permission, we wanted to share some snippets of their stories with all of you:
> _“By cancelling my student loan debt, that means I can now focus on paying off my car and start saving up for grad school or a home. It also gives me some breathing room which means I can continue to support small businesses in my community.”_ —Jesus, Arizona
> _“Since I graduated from college, my student loan payment has been my largest monthly bill after rent... This plan will significantly lower my monthly payment and allow me to pursue my farm dream without the burden of student loan debt weighing me down.”_ —Bobbi, Oregon
> _“I had so much anxiety about how I was going to make student loan payments when the moratorium is lifted. [The] income-based payment plans don't seem to take into account whether or not you're the single parent of a child, which I am. I cannot put into words the relief I am currently feeling.”_ —Kaneisha, Texas
> _“I paid off my student loan 48 years ago...after the difficulties I endured on a 3% APR loan, I cannot imagine the agony of modern student debt! I applaud Joe Biden for reducing some or all of that anxiety.”_ —Richard, Ohio
> _“At 17 and 18 years old, so many of us are faced with a question. Take out student loans, and go to the school of your dreams you worked so hard for and will change your life forever? Or don't because it's too expensive, and settle for the life you don't want to live? ...We are teenagers, how are we supposed to make life altering financial decisions?...This is the step towards freedom and hope.”_ —Kamran, New York
We’re thrilled to hear from so many of our supporters about the life progress they’ll be able to make without worrying about their loan payments. **But there is still so much work to be done.** As so many of you shared, President Biden’s plan is a great first step, but it should be viewed as exactly that: a _first_ step, not the last.
> _“This will alleviate the $6,000 of federal debt that I have, but the majority of what I owe is through a private loan...I wish I could be as happy as some others, but I feel forgotten.”_ —Kyle, New York
> _“Loan cancellation will not help me because my balance is over $150,000 despite many years of paying...Every month I don’t have to pay student loans is a month in which I put money back into my community and into the health of my family."_ —Jennie, New York

Peter, Xin lỗi - that means sorry in Vietnamese.
Simple words like “sorry” were foreign to me when I came to America.
We were refugees from Communist Vietnam, and this new country was large and unfamiliar - but I knew even as a kid that it was the land of opportunity.

clean_body: | | | Peter, Xin lỗi - that means sorry in Vietnamese. Simple words like “sorry” were foreign to me when I came to America. We were refugees from Communist Vietnam, and this new country was large and unfamiliar - but I knew even as a kid that it was the land of opportunity. I couldn’t let the incredible second chance I got in America go to waste. I studied day and night to learn English, and by the time I was 18, I was enrolled in the Naval Academy. Only in America could a little boy who didn’t know a word of English grow up to be an officer in the greatest fighting force in the world. I didn’t get this far in life because of government handouts or political correctness. I worked hard, I had faith, and I never doubted that the American Dream was in reach - and that terrifies Nancy Pelosi. I’m not oppressed or in need of the government’s help. I’m an American just like you. And right now, I’m fighting the radical Left to keep that dream alive for generations to come. | | | Peter My name is Amanda Adkins. I know your inbox is probably flooded with emails, so I’ll be quick: [My friend Regan Deering is officially the Republican nominee running in one of the most competitive races in the country. Election experts just gave Democrats a SLIGHT EDGE in her race but I KNOW in my heart of hearts she WILL win this key race if every Patriot donates $10 now!](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=8b82fa0ec0&e=2fa613cb76) Why? Because Regan is not just another one of the D.C. insiders who wants to be a career politician for the rest of her life. She comes from a background of being a teacher and a small businesswoman. **She knows what America needs right now, and it’s NOT liberal indoctrination in our classrooms or higher taxes. ** We need a secure border. We need to take care of our veterans. We need to get inflation under control. We need to hold Joe Biden accountable. We need to focus on election integrity. And most importantly, we need to take back control of Congress from the liberal Democrats. **And if she wins her race, we certainly will. ** But Regan has a lot of hurdles in front of her. First of all, she is running in what we call an OPEN SEAT – that means it’s vacant. And it’s also extremely competitive. The Senate is back in session in just a few days, folks — and we have a lot of work to do. We’ve had incredible wins lately. President Biden just signed Senate Democrats’ _Inflation Reduction Act_ into law to take urgent climate action and cut everyday costs like prescription drug prices and energy bills. And the president’s student loan debt forgiveness program is a big step toward providing economic relief and the opportunity for financial stability for about 228,000 New Mexicans. But there’s still so much more we can do to make healthcare and higher education more affordable, address the climate crisis, and protect reproductive rights. These are all issues I’ll be fighting for in the weeks to come. But I want to know your priorities, too, as I chart a path ahead. Vikram For N.H. Releases Latest T.V. Ad: FIX THIS MESS
---
CONCORD, NH - September 2, 2022 - Today, first generation American, businessman, and U.S. Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani released a new T.V. ad entitled Fix This Mess, highlighting his unique political outsider story. In a race full of career politicians, the ad celebrates Vikram's business experience. While Vikram's opponents have spent their lives running for office, Vikram has been running businesses. The Washington elites have bankrupted our nation and corrupted our education system, and the only way to fix this mess is with a political outsider who understands what Granite State families are going through. Vikram states: "As I travel around talking to Granite Staters, one theme remains constant. The career politicians have failed us. None of us feel represented by those who go to Washington more focussed on filling their pockets than representing their neighbors. We need a senator with the real world experience to give the people of New Hampshire a voice in government."
The ad, the campaign's fourth of the primary, will air through September 13.

Vikram states: "As I travel around talking to Granite Staters, one theme remains constant. The career politicians have failed us. None of us feel represented by those who go to Washington more focussed on filling their pockets than representing their neighbors. We need a senator with the real world experience to give the people of New Hampshire a voice in government." The ad, the campaign's fourth of the primary, will air through September 13. **Here's the thing: We know that Chrissy – a mom, teacher, and veteran – is the best choice to represent PA-06, and she'll continue to fight for working families when reelected – but first we have to win in November.**
That's why we need to make sure we have enough resources to fight back against the inevitably loud GOP attacks and continue to spread Chrissy's message to voters.
So Derek, please chip in $5 or whatever you can right now to help us stop Kevin McCarthy’s plans and ensure we keep PA-06 blue. subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61172841:6yssIVVON:m:1:3331421248:ABC6397248A6CBBF9419A0E842FCFE0D:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Peter,

In Congress, my priorities will be:

Investing in our children’s futures by passing universal pre-k funded by the federal government, not local taxes.
Making college more affordable by doubling the amount of Pell Grants and investing in programs like RI Promise that provide two years of community college at no cost to students.
Securing good jobs for our students by supporting robust career training, apprenticeship, and workforce development programs.

While President Biden’s effort to forgive student loan debt for so many is a good start, we need to do more to address the cost of college in the long run—and to make it part of an education system that closes the skills gap and increases economic mobility for students and families. In Congress, I will work to make sure college and career pathways are accessible for all. I ask that you help me get there by donating to our campaign.

Thank you for your support,

Joy

clean_body: I’ll be blunt: I need your help | Hey Peter, I bet you could guess what I’m about to say. But please listen to what I have to say. I’ll be blunt: Republican fundraising is down across the board, and well-funded Dems are taking to the airwaves to attack us. In the last month, we were outspent 7 to 1 on TV alone. Our campaign is reaching another fundraising deadline, and we’re behind our goal. Please trust me when I say that fundraising is absolutely crucial to our campaign. We need materials for our volunteers, yard signs for our supporters, and funds to run ads. | I understand that you may not have much to give, but I promise you that every dollar invested in our campaign brings us one step closer to restoring our American way of life and stopping the woke Biden agenda. I promise you that I will work hard to secure our border, stop inflation, and defend our freedoms. If you have stored your payment information with WinRed, your donation will process immediately. | ---|--- | | | Thanks in advance, Ted Budd | Ted Budd is a father, small business owner, and conservative leader running for Senate in North Carolina. He is the ONLY candidate who is endorsed by President Trump and the only candidate who will fight for the America First Agenda in Washington. subject: Last night President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for. We need to stand with him now so he can pass more of his agenda over the next two years.
body:
Biden needs us to have his back now
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter _**,**_ **Last night President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for.** [**Can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td7d70a87-ea94-4881-bb9e-5e30de6ff28c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _He called out Republicans who call Democrats names like it's a bodily function, but have been whining since the moment he referred to MAGA Republicans as "semi-fascist." The poor dears._ **_Baby killer. Communist. Chris Killer. America Hater. Libt*rd. These are just some of the many things I've been called, and not just by random Twitter users, but by elected & appointed GOP officeholders, as well as prominent Republican pundits and writers._ ** The entire GOP culture is based around "owning the libs" at this point, which means basing your existence in politics on hurting your opponents, as opposed to doing anything good or constructive for your constituents, the country or really anyone. And it shows in their behavior. **_But like any bully, they crawl up in a ball when you hit back. And last night Biden hit back. He pointed out Trump cult's attacks on democracy, on the rule of law and the threats and intimidation that are second nature to them. And they're not used to this! So today they are lashing out like toddlers on a playground fighting over a swing._**

| This is an incredible development, and one of which we should all be proud. I have talked on this list before about how our lack of messaging about our achievements, and about who they really are, hurts us in elections. Well, with some of the younger Democrats like Reps. Ruben Gallego, Eric Swalwell and Katie Porter, Senators like Cory Booker and Brian Schatz and Governors and candidates like Beto O'Rourke, Stacey Abrams, John Fetterman & Gretchen Whitmer leading the way, we are changing the culture of our party. _If I could sum it up, I'd quote the late Patrick Swayze from the film Road House. "Be nice. Until it's time not to be nice."_ **_Sometimes, you need to punch a bully in the nose. And that's what we're now doing. So as a HUGE THANK YOU for Joe Biden's speech last night, I'd like to ask you to join us in donating to the Democratic National Committee (DNC) today. It feels very much like they're ready to roll, and role over Republicans, in November. _** [**They got our message, let's make sure we reinforce it with financial support so they have the resources to win an overwhelming victory in November! So can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc334fc2-7c7f-446d-9e2e-1b5cec525d5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this fight for, as Joe Biden puts it, "the soul of our nation." clean_body: Biden needs us to have his back now | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter , Last night President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for. He called out Republicans who call Democrats names like it's a bodily function, but have been whining since the moment he referred to MAGA Republicans as "semi-fascist." The poor dears. Baby killer. Communist. Chris Killer. America Hater. Libtrd. These are just some of the many things I've been called, and not just by random Twitter users, but by elected & appointed GOP officeholders, as well as prominent Republican pundits and writers. The entire GOP culture is based around "owning the libs" at this point, which means basing your existence in politics on hurting your opponents, as opposed to doing anything good or constructive for your constituents, the country or really anyone. And it shows in their behavior. But like any bully, they crawl up in a ball when you hit back. And last night Biden hit back. He pointed out Trump cult's attacks on democracy, on the rule of law and the threats and intimidation that are second nature to them. And they're not used to this! So today they are lashing out like toddlers on a playground fighting over a swing. | | | | | | This is an incredible development, and one of which we should all be proud. I have talked on this list before about how our lack of messaging about our achievements, and about who they really are, hurts us in elections. Well, with some of the younger Democrats like Reps. Ruben Gallego, Eric Swalwell and Katie Porter, Senators like Cory Booker and Brian Schatz and Governors and candidates like Beto O'Rourke, Stacey Abrams, John Fetterman & Gretchen Whitmer leading the way, we are changing the culture of our party. If I could sum it up, I'd quote the late Patrick Swayze from the film Road House. "Be nice. Until it's time not to be nice." Sometimes, you need to punch a bully in the nose. And that's what we're now doing. So as a HUGE THANK YOU for Joe Biden's speech last night, I'd like to ask you to join us in donating to the Democratic National Committee (DNC) today. It feels very much like they're ready to roll, and role over Republicans, in November. Thank you for being a part of this fight for, as Joe Biden puts it, "the soul of our nation." | | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61173777:6xc0IVVIN:m:1:3317145305:A8A91D47636BE088958C8EB16C19439C:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

So I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for – and why winning here in Georgia matters so much.
Our movement is about building a better, brighter future for all. It's about ensuring that everyone has an equal voice in our government – and a fair shot at the American dream.
That means defending and expanding our constitutional right to vote. It means protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet.
Friend, our movement is about you – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. That's why it's so important to have you by my side for the critical fights ahead – fights we can only win if we win this election first.
You see, polls show me 1 point behind my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker – who seems to care more about courting favor from Donald Trump than he does about addressing the issues that matter to Georgians. But GOP donors are pouring over $20 MILLION into his campaign to defeat me, and I can't fight back without your help.
This campaign is fueled entirely by grassroots support, without a cent from corporate PACs. So today, I'm personally asking for your help to power our movement to victory: Will you chip in $5 now – split between my campaign and Serve America – to help me win in Georgia, defend our Democratic Senate majority, and continue fighting for progress? It's an honor to fight for you and beside you. Thank you so much for being part of this movement.
– Rev. Raphael Warnock

Friend,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what’s never going to change.

**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdh7hvhbq5gd9fi0n97babicuni5ct6ga131lcsg_rp22sh2s8i66or2chgmcob4c5h2bs)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what’d I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state’s $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer’s Cabinet.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztsovk90vu3mm3541p7ah2v9jbgcvgfbnn9tf0b0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chgmcob4c5h2bs)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zne9j4id120cn2p629o0qmlbt9lne483hp82k440_rp22sh2s8i66or2chgmcob4c5h2bs)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I’m always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That’s not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I’m going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children.**

That won’t change, I’d rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I’ve given you my story in a nutshell, I’m going to humbly ask for your support. I’ve got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you’re able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zthqpmb1n3dv89ck2np1mcgp55fkrgmhqnc2sb3o_rp22sh2s8i66or2chgmcob4c5h2bs)** | [**DONATE $500**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2010rq8b2d6a2a7iu9tlsdf3ipn9m29392a8bv0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chgmcob4c5h2bs)

| | **September 2, 2022 | Small Business Edition**
---
| | **Delegate Greenhalgh's Business Background**
---
| |
---
| | Karen founded her first business, Heritage Woodworks Inc., in 1987 out of her home's garage. Her business went on to become a highly successful custom cabinet manufacturing facility with over 30 employees. After 20 years as owner and operator, she sold her business which remains open and profitable to this day. Karen started her second business in 2018. The founding of Cyber Tygr was prompted by her experience managing local medical centers in which she saw a need for economical cybersecurity and privacy solutions in healthcare. Cyber Tygr has supported leading edge organizations like Mayo Clinic and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).
---
| | |
---
| | **Small Business Commission**
---
| | Delegate Greenhalgh was honored to receive an appointment to the Small Business Commission. She is ready to use her own business background to address issues of concern for small businesses in Virginia!
---
| | |
---
| | **The HIVE Business Resource Center**
---
---
| | Last week Delegate Greenhalgh made a trip to The HIVE in Virginia Beach's Town Center. The HIVE is a business resource center that offers various resources and support to the small business community in Hampton Roads. Ihsane Mouak, from the Virginia Beach Department of Economic Development, met with Delegate Greenhalgh to discuss the free training, mentorship opportunities, and consulting services available to guide small business owners to growth and success.

body:
Campaigns are won and lost on a series of tough choices.
#

Friends —
I made a tough call a few days ago.
We had a team meeting to discuss the “red wave” of cash and the onslaught of ads attacking Mark that are heading our way. It was clear that to fight back and set the record straight we needed to double down on our ads and outreach.
I gave it a green light, even though we weren’t sure we had the budget room to do so.
The bet I made was that Mark’s supporters would come through and close the budget gap, just like this team has over and over again in the last four years.
But then we missed our fundraising goal in August. A ton of people chipped in, and from the heart: I’m really grateful for that. But we still came up short. And that puts an extraordinary amount of pressure on us to reach our goals in September — especially since this is the last FEC deadline month before Election Day.

Peter,

While the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) has brought

Victory Fund this year to support their corporate candidates, Justice
Democrats has raised money from grassroots donors to support grassroots,
progressive candidates.

Peter. We always operate on a
tight budget, using everything we can to re-elect the Squad, help new
leaders like Summer Lee and Greg Casar defeat the establishment, and
advocate for progressive change. But money is especially tight right now,
and our fundraising over the next few months will determine how much we
can invest in November and recruiting the next Summer Lee, AOC, or Cori
Bush to run in 2024.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113935?refcode=em20220902-24973&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=24973%2E1203867%2Erxg-R- ]Contribute

Our online fundraising has gone down almost every month this year. We’re
13.7% behind where we were at this point last year in our ActBlue. Up

won’t cut it.

The amount of grassroots dollars we can bring in directly impacts how many

We’ve got a lot of work to do, Peter —

now. Help us grow the Squad and defeat the Democratic establishment in
primaries.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

body:
and what has Washington done about it? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/5a043f11b5c3/valerie-offers-no-solutions-in-town-hall-last-night-9059653?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| | Dear Peter,
---
| The media has stopped talking about it, but baby formula shortages are STILL happening right in our neighborhoods. Sure, the “nightly newscasts” several months ago showed numerous giant USAF cargo planes flying into air bases in the Midwest full of pallets of desperately needed formula, but this issue is still plaguing parents of infants across our country and right here in our own communities.

A recent visit to several of the Walgreens stores in the 4th District confirmed my suspicions that the Biden administration prizes photo opportunities rather than real problem solving.

Parents are driving from store to store to find empty shelves. It’s a huge burden, taking time and money away from families. What if baby has special needs or dietary restrictions? Who can afford this when gas prices are already sky high and everything costs a fortune right now?

Supply shortages have been driving inflation and what have you seen done about this?

**_More spending._** (And none of these dollars are going to trouble shooting...unless tens of thousands of IRS agents plan to tackle this issue, but I digress.) Today's reality is driven by yesterday's policies, and yesterday's policies are driven by our career politicians. A friend recently defined "politicians" as "single-minded seekers of re-election" and that couldn't be more true. We need problem solvers in Washington, not folks content to warm seats at the Capital. I'm Courtney Geels and I’m a nurse running to represent you in Congress. I need your help fighting these career politicians. My husband and I dream of having our first child one day and being able to provide for that baby in lots of ways, but most certainly at the very basic of needs: FOOD.

Together, I know we can build a better future for our children.

For truth, justice, and unity, Courtney Geels

clean_body: and what has Washington done about it? | | | | | Dear Peter, | The media has stopped talking about it, but baby formula shortages are STILL happening right in our neighborhoods. Sure, the “nightly newscasts” several months ago showed numerous giant USAF cargo planes flying into air bases in the Midwest full of pallets of desperately needed formula, but this issue is still plaguing parents of infants across our country and right here in our own communities. A recent visit to several of the Walgreens stores in the 4th District confirmed my suspicions that the Biden administration prizes photo opportunities rather than real problem solving. Parents are driving from store to store to find empty shelves. It’s a huge burden, taking time and money away from families. What if baby has special needs or dietary restrictions? Who can afford this when gas prices are already sky high and everything costs a fortune right now? Supply shortages have been driving inflation and what have you seen done about this? More spending. (And none of these dollars are going to trouble shooting...unless tens of thousands of IRS agents plan to tackle this issue, but I digress.) Today's reality is driven by yesterday's policies, and yesterday's policies are driven by our career politicians. A friend recently defined "politicians" as "single-minded seekers of re-election" and that couldn't be more true. We need problem solvers in Washington, not folks content to warm seats at the Capital. I'm Courtney Geels and I’m a nurse running to represent you in Congress. subject: I know how much $5 is.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SCOTT FOR SENATE
body:
|
---
| | |
Peter,

I know that asking for money is hard. I know that asking for something as little as $5 can be even harder. To a lot of people $5 is a lot.

It was a lot for me growing up. I was raised in a single parent household in North Charleston, South Carolina. My mom worked 16-hour days to keep food on the table and a roof over our heads. I got my first job, changing oil at a gas station, when I was 13.

**I understand the value of a dollar.**

I don't take asking for money lightly. I know that every donation made is a sacrifice and I am forever grateful for each and every gift.

With that being said, it would mean so much to me if you could chip in $5 to make sure we beat our goal.

Thank you so much. I know that chipping in any amount can be hard - but if I meet my goal, I can continue this fight for folks like you.

-Tim

If Republicans have enough support to take back the Senate, we can secure hope, prosperity, and American values for generations to come.

An invitation to join me alongside LG Winsome Earle-Sears as well as a legislative update.
| | |

| | [](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fbrycereeves.com/1/01000182fef15829-1bf36b1b-27d8-4598-aea7-007330542784-000000/GcjO7t0gopLjOQneGcbZmjH1T9U=285)
---
| Friends, I just wanted to reach out one more time to remind you all of an event that I am hosting alongside Senator DeSteph of Virginia Beach. We're both extremely grateful that our Lieutenant Governor and President of the VA Senate, Mrs. Winsome Earle-Sears will join us in support as we prepare for next year.
---
| | |
---
| The Lieutenant Governor, Delegate Freitas, Dr. Alveda King, and myself at the March for Life this past April.
---
| I have made sure to include the flyer below for your convenience. The event will be this coming Tuesday, the 6th from 4-6PM. We'll have some beer, cider, and BBQ to keep the Summer going just one more day beyond Labor Day. As we approach the upcoming 2023 Legislative Session, I am doing everything I can to make sure that our Commonwealth works for you. With the recent passage of California's rolling ban on new gas-powered vehicles, many are worried about the direction our country is going. To top it all off, [in 2021 Virginia Democrats passed a law tying our emissions standards to California](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.virginiamercury.com%2F2022%2F08%2F26%2Fcalifornias-2035-ban-on-new-gas-powered-cars-set-to-apply-to-virginia%2F%3Ffbclid=IwAR3GORoyrCBt3LDEBsvzHXlc9LMXVdEWcVGtVcdzvhaLYggETEl9Z9cDGTM/1/01000182fef15829-1bf36b1b-27d8-4598-aea7-007330542784-000000/lRtZYQfZftfTaJg23gp_SeVpZyE=285), which will eventually obligate us to follow that very same ban unless repealed. Ironically, only a few weeks after the passage of California's rolling ban, [the State is asking that folks refrain from charging their electric vehicles due to grid problems](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.nytimes.com%2F2022%2F09%2F01%2Fus%2Fcalifornia-heat-wave-flex-alert-ac-ev-charging.html/1/01000182fef15829-1bf36b1b-27d8-4598-aea7-007330542784-000000/JONpuzrIy51oMjlj-mVussLZmAg=285). If they can't handle the electric cars they already have, how do they expect to handle more? With Virginia families struggling to put gas in the cars they already own and working overtime just to stock their pantries with the basics, we simply cannot afford this out-of-touch legislation.

To combat this, I have submitted a draft of a bill to repeal the law tying us to California. I humbly ask that you reach out to your elected officials and respectfully request that they support a repeal of [HB1965](https://j0l1y7h.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Flegp604.exe%3Fses=212%26typ=bil%26val=hb1965/1/01000182fef15829-1bf36b1b-27d8-4598-aea7-007330542784-000000/7egW50KnAU92HeS5agF8o_bhwyU=285). You would think the need to unwind this law would be apparent, but sometimes it takes constituent outreach to drive the point home. Thank you all for taking the time to read my email. As always, I am humbled and honored to be able to serve you as your representative in Richmond. I look forward to the coming session, and will never stop fighting to keep conservative values alive and well in Virginia. Yours in Service,
---

| Peter-
Joe Biden just delivered what amounts to possibly the most demagogic, divisive, and destructive speech by a President of the United States.
I'll sum up the speech for you in case you were lucky enough not to see it:
Joe Biden said that Republicans - half of the country - "do not respect the Constitution. They do not believe in the rule of law. They do not recognize the will of the people." Joe Biden went on to say that Republicans "fan the flames of political violence"... are a "threat to our personal rights"... and are "determined to take this country backwards."
They say pictures are worth a thousand words, and the terrible tenor of Joe Biden's speech was captured in one image. See for yourself:
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016SgbcDDi5epna5kT3Lh_-dGSA79jePdyXPfXlObssrTSNvnCieBzwnvBv6aufmmVawi9AAJ9KExjMUbRwTsnl5V1lZVM_26AHrTC3cavzwMkF4VCInUIhrBdRvDEhKsNimCaozjJqW1crtc77Su3bk1itgjsoKyGUMagG-hzoxPIJ5HbuLWbKrbVMy912AOGsx_Fhs9fOL_sERSo_wm3jDImPt73KoWxE-1JspNyQoR5X7wefz5LGBWDVTForaRXEN2eUhWzvcsGlUjP8zTmgsYZXjOIcVjtzRToh3Jg4UUpaaA4Jcmz6dNBWNCZLnfM&c=dNsh_xGZ_NKtt9xH8DsfaE0kPntcyckFaGXRinY9ka8oBr5Nl3f6ug==&ch=qJ561bQlhXgcjVwCc3_IhBUDcrW_CLZFa-3TefLhrtzh83btwWGWug==)
---
| So much for what Joe Biden said in November 2020, when he said, "I will work to be a president who seeks not to divide but unify. I won't see red states and blue states, I will always see the United States."
That was obviously a lie, as we heard clearly in Biden's speech last night. Not only was it a speech full of lies, hate, and vitriol, it lacked self-awareness to an unbelievable degree.
Respect for the Constitution? How does attacking our Second Amendment rights, like this administration and their allies in Congress have done repeatedly, amount to respecting our Constitution? How about attacking the First Amendment rights of parents protesting school board meetings and likening them to domestic terrorists?
Respect for the rule of law? Tell that to the Texas border counties who are threatened every single day by the worst border crisis in decades or the Americans living in cities overrun by crime because Democrats refuse to uphold our country's laws.
Fanning the flames of political violence? A would-be assassin literally showed up at the house of a Supreme Court Justice to murder him and his family because of the rhetoric of this president and his party after a Supreme Court decision they didn't like.
This shows you exactly how desperate Democrats are to hold onto power in November. They will say and do anything to keep Republicans from taking back control of Congress, even if it means painting half of the country as Constitution-hating, racist deplorables simply because people are fed up with the disastrous consequences of one-party rule in Washington.
We need to fight back, but we need to fight to win. The way we respond to a speech like that is by committing all of our time, resources, and energy into taking back the House and Senate. We respond by offering the American people an inspiring, uplifting alternative to the divisive demagoguery we saw from President Biden last night. That's how we show Joe Biden and his Democrat allies in Congress that a speech like that doesn't discourage us, it motivates us to action.
I'm ready to do that, and I know you are too. [We are going to win this election with patriots like you in this fight.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016SgbcDDi5epna5kT3Lh_-dGSA79jePdyXPfXlObssrTSNvnCieBzwnvBv6aufmmVawi9AAJ9KExjMUbRwTsnl5V1lZVM_26AHrTC3cavzwMkF4VCInUIhrBdRvDEhKsNimCaozjJqW1crtc77Su3bk1itgjsoKyGUMagG-hzoxPIJ5HbuLWbKrbVMy912AOGsx_Fhs9fOL_sERSo_wm3jDImPt73KoWxE-1JspNyQoR5X7wefz5LGBWDVTForaRXEN2eUhWzvcsGlUjP8zTmgsYZXjOIcVjtzRToh3Jg4UUpaaA4Jcmz6dNBWNCZLnfM&c=dNsh_xGZ_NKtt9xH8DsfaE0kPntcyckFaGXRinY9ka8oBr5Nl3f6ug==&ch=qJ561bQlhXgcjVwCc3_IhBUDcrW_CLZFa-3TefLhrtzh83btwWGWug==)

name: Joe Kent
subject: Finish the Fight!
body:
Dear Patriot,
I cannot express my gratitude to you for your support of my campaign. We needed every dollar you gave us to get across the finish line in the primary.
We succeeded in winning by a margin that surpassed the need for a recount - and I attribute that to the many donations we got after the election that funded our effort to 'cure' our supporters ballots that were rejected due to "signature mismatch" (including my own!)
The DC Establishment was furious at my victory. They spent over $6 million to defeat me - and still lost. But they see the General Election as one last opportunity to block me and my America First agenda from getting to Congress. They do not want me to hold the Biden administration accountable for record inflation, a self-inflicted recession, crippling gas prices, the disasters in Afghanistan and Iraq, and the disturbing actions of the FBI.
Please, help me finish the fight by donating at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/SadegVi5eVMAzLfHJk7RBw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w).
Unfortunately, we exhausted our campaign funds to win the primary, and we are in a unique pinch: not only did we have a late primary where the official outcome was further delayed by two weeks, voting in Washington State starts three weeks sooner than it does in the rest of the country. Every voter in the district will be _mailed_ a ballot in mid-October.
This greatly constrains the timeframe we have to raise the money we need to get TV ads up, send out direct mail, and expand our door knocking program.
Please help us recharge our campaign account with generous donation at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/SadegVi5eVMAzLfHJk7RBw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w).
Thank you,
Joe Kent
PS: We exhausted our cash-on-hand to win the primary and now the DC Establishment sees one last opportunity to prevent me from getting to Congress by defeating me in the General Election. Help me finish the fight by donating today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/SadegVi5eVMAzLfHJk7RBw/Y7Oge4DcWOPalUJip763Nz5w).

Friend,

I am writing to express how grateful I am for your support throughout this campaign. We rely on grassroots support from folks like you, and I would have it no other way.

Throughout this campaign, it has become so clear to me that Georgians are ready for change. I am so proud to report that – with your help – we managed to reach our end-of-month fundraising goal for August. Can you help defend LGBTQ+ freedom?
Friend,
This is Malcolm Kenyatta, and as you may know, I am the first LGBTQ+ elected official of color to serve in the Pennsylvania General Assembly and the first openly LGBTQ+ person of color to run for US Senate in American history.
**I’m reaching out because LGBTQ+ rights and reproductive healthcare are under attack.**
The repeal of Roe v. Wade — and Justice Clarence Thomas’ concurrent opinion which opens the door to repeal same-sex marriage and LGBTQ+ rights — changed the landscape dramatically.
Coupled with the record number of anti-LGBTQ+ laws being introduced at all levels of government this year, it’s clear _our fundamental freedoms are on the line._
We can’t stand on the sidelines. **We must take the fight directly to those who attack our rights. **
I’m proud to announce Agenda PAC — a new organization that will hold anti-LGBTQ+ and anti-choice politicians accountable — and defend vulnerable pro-choice elected officials who advocate for LGBTQ+ rights.
I’m about to tell you more, but first, **[can you help defend LGBTQ+ rights and reproductive freedom by becoming a founding donor today? **We must fight back, friend.** That’s why I’m proud to stand with other national LGBTQ+ leaders like Sen. Shevrin Jones, the first LGBTQ+ Black person elected to the Florida Legislature, and Sen. Megan Hunt, the first openly LGBTQ+ person elected to Nebraska’s unicameral legislature, in launching **Agenda PAC — a new organization dedicated to holding anti-LGBTQ+ politicians accountable.**
With your support, we will stand up to the worst far-right politicians out there.
At the state level, our first priority will be defeating Pennsylvania GOP gubernatorial nominee Doug Mastriano – the most radical anti-LGBTQ+ candidate in the nation.
At the federal level, we will focus on defeating the most extreme members of Congress candidates who attack our community.
**Together, we can stand up for our rights and take back our power.** Now, with less than two months under the critical 2022 midterms, we need all hands on deck to defend our fundamental freedoms.

Chip in whatever you can afford and become a founding donor of Agenda PAC today >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50159098/364826562/-22633583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc1MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTQ3ZjBiYy0wMDJiLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gkQuh0xhcMhHjqdPOSJcQda8iWa1jD9e62AXBwzxsqE=)**

subject: Biden Attacks Our Values
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Patriots, The President of the United States has initiated an unprecedented assault on the American people and the values that have made our nation a beacon of freedom and opportunity. In a speech perfectly suited for an authoritarian strongman, President Biden, with clenched fists and ominous blood-red lighting casting shadows on the very building where the Declaration of Independence was signed, declared war on half the nation by referring to “MAGA Republicans” as a “threat to this country.” Our nation, our communities, and our neighbors are in crisis. Far-left radicals have spent decades transforming America’s institutions into bastions of woke progressive extremism. A feckless GOP establishment has sat idle, content to watch the snowballing destruction in a vain bid to maintain its hold on power. As a result, our way of life and the very fabric of the great American experiment in freedom is threatening to unravel. And now, President Biden has zeroed in on liberty-loving Americans who refuse to accede to the left’s radical socialist agenda as enemies of the state. This comes as the radical left and their GOP establishment enablers are doubling down on their destructive policies: **skyrocketing inflation, out-of-control crime, a wide-open border** controlled by murderous drug cartels, **schools filled with radical Marxists** pushing divisive and harmful ideologies on race and biology, rogue federal agencies **waging war on their own citizens** , and **families crushed** by increasing costs of gasoline and home energy bills. The fight for America’s future is upon us. Will you answer the call to take back our nation and restore an America that is **strong, prosperous, and free**? If the answer is yes, then the State Freedom Caucus Network stands with you to wage–and **win** –this fight beyond the confines of the corrupt corridors of Washington D.C. Freedom-loving Americans must pivot and focus on restoring and nurturing liberty in our home states. After all, it is in our home states where our freedoms and way of life will either be won or lost. Over the past several years, states like Florida and Georgia have begun to show the way out of the never-ending nightmare of the D.C. Swamp. Our federalist system implemented by our nation’s founders enshrines the states as sovereign entities that have both the power and ability to put Washington in its place. The time has come to do exactly that. The State Freedom Caucus Network is helping to create freedom caucuses in the 50 state capitols - modeled after the successful House Freedom Caucus. The Network is equipping liberty-minded state lawmakers with the resources, policy knowledge, and procedural strategies they need to ensure the rights of their citizens are protected and the progressive policies crushing American households are dismantled. We have already seen astounding momentum. In less than a year, the Network has launched seven official freedom caucuses in legislatures across the nation–including Georgia, South Carolina, Illinois, Arizona, Nevada, South Dakota, and Mississippi. The Network is giving voice to the millions of freedom-loving Americans across our nation fighting to bring an end to the cultural, economic, and political madness inflicted by far-left radicals upon hardworking Americans and their families. However, even in deeply red states, conservative lawmakers often find themselves outgunned and outmanned by long-time establishment Republicans dedicated to preserving their power and doling out political favors instead of protecting their constituents from the radicalism of today’s Democrat Party. After President Biden’s ominous speech, this milquetoast status quo is something we can no longer afford. The Network is fighting to defeat the radical left and bring an end to the establishment’s stranglehold on our state legislatures to finally push conservative policies across the finish line. **But we need your help to succeed.** All too often, the political focus remains on the day-to-day happenings in our nation’s capital when critical cultural and political battles are being waged much closer to home with far more immediate consequences. These state-level battles **must be won if freedom is to be preserved.** This work is vital and growing more important by the day as the Biden administration and the radicals it has emboldened press their attack on our values and on the very idea of freedom itself. **Will you consider helping our efforts and fighting alongside us? ** **For just $10 a month, you can support the State Freedom Caucus Network as it works to secure liberty at the state level and finally bring your voice to your state capitol. ** **Click[here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=629afbb849&e=64ecec6d03) to set up your recurring monthly donation now. Even $25 or $50 will make a huge difference.** Thanks to your help and your commitment to the ideas that have made America the indispensable nation, we know we will win. Keep fighting, Andy Roth President, State Freedom Caucus Network P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation’s state capitols and in your home state. Please consider a [contribution here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=1cb3ac9dd1&e=64ecec6d03) and join us as together we work to advance the cause of liberty.

After President Biden’s ominous speech, this milquetoast status quo is something we can no longer afford. body:
A new study has said that Missourians could witness 125-degree days within our lifetime.
| |
Peter, in the last few months, Missourians have weathered both record-breaking flash floods in St. Louis and devastating droughts in the farmland. **And now, a new study has said that Missourians could witness 125-degree days _within our lifetime._**
These weather catastrophes aren't just happening in Missouri. In Appalachia, there have been deadly, terrifying floods. Wildfires devastate the West Coast. Unprecedented heat waves are happening across America and around the world. All the while, sea levels are rising everywhere.
We are in a climate emergency. **We are seeing it firsthand in Missouri, in Appalachia, and in practically every corner of the globe. And it is not going away anytime soon.**
Until we take action to stop this climate crisis, we will continue to see farmers grappling with failed crops and droughts, communities devastated by floods, hurricanes, and wildfires, ranchers struggling to feed and water their livestock, and families unable to keep cool as our energy grid strains under pressure.
**This isn't the next generation's battle; this is our battle, and we need to know where you stand. Please, before our live poll closes at 11:59 p.m. tonight, will you respond to make your voice heard?**

name: Dr. Nithin Paul
subject: Matt and Cynthia’s new ad
body:
| | | Hi Friend, I’m Nithin – I work as a primary care doctor in Woonsocket and I met some of you this past winter at the sleepout action that Matt and Cynthia led at the State House. Earlier this week I narrated a new TV ad for Matt and Cynthia’s campaign, which they’re releasing today. Check it out here: [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhs0h48ouTXqh0NiA4ruJVVFNM0d-fQR6qhGIARS0-Qr9KhgOjn6XUs9L9-BAszWLNZva44tcUHIyE9Ti9o4_suYYUppuyQboE8IFhA44zI_4kmWjF7a8h4Uhm6s6KA8BIIVpt4Iq9fQfOn0ZnwR1OypAt9xIspuz7Vhh_0d9BHeVagkffsSQZyeZ33T-VmB3wCypL6IAJ9gTQKrSXdDiegnw1hSgqBevHSxKvS03jR-X1PConAQGMqPHwuBxvkcWufsNAvfiBgmrpzlyHMJrl9Q/3p4/74MSEFTSQP-nYNR29kfDjw/h0/kuotB3_9YUBPKiIv4WRxSflgCQkWb3RAZTGAH6_KTqw) The ad tells the story of how Matt, Cynthia, and dozens of community members slept outside of the RI State House for 16 nights in December to demand that the government address the homelessness crisis. After failing to act on this looming crisis for 10 months, in response to this action, the state committed to create over 400 new shelter spaces for unhoused Rhode Islanders in two weeks. But we know so much more needs to be done. Matt and Cynthia’s leadership in organizing and bringing together our communities during this action showed exactly what kind of leaders they’ll be as governor and lieutenant governor. Now, we have less than 70 days left — that’s about nine weeks — to keep our TV ads on the air, order more yard signs, hold more events, and get out the vote across New Mexico’s 2nd congressional district. body:
KeithPekau.com |
---
| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=dddff23394&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

This week, I took a common sense position. The Downers Grove Public Library planned to use taxpayer funds to hold a drag performance targeted to children in grades 7-12. I said this was an inappropriate use of taxpayer funds.

My position is one shared by parents and taxpayers across the district, who don’t want this event just as they don’t want the library introducing kids to straight sex by holding a burlesque show. I made it clear that I had no interest in regulating the private, consensual activities and decisions of adults. This event, however, targeted children. It’s inappropriate, and an unacceptable use of taxpayer funds.

I called on Sean Casten to join me in denouncing this event. His response was to call me homophobic. It came as no surprise. For years, Casten’s first line of defense has been to go straight to name-calling. He calls anyone who disagrees with his far-left radical views racist, homophobic or any other number of slurs. Politicians like Casten are the reason nothing gets done in Congress. How can anyone work with someone who goes straight to name calling rather than discussing differences of opinion like an adult?

I hold the same position as the majority of common-sense people in this district, as well as a pro-Liberty LGBT group, who endorsed me and joined our movement to push back on demagogues like Sean Casten.

Yesterday, The Log Cabin Republicans (LCR) formally endorsed me for Congress in Illinois’ Sixth District.

Charles T. Moran, LCR President, said of Pekau, _"Keith Pekau is a father, husband, and combat veteran that Illinois needs in Congress. Keith has a proven track record of winning tough races and producing results for his community. Log Cabin Republicans endorses Keith Pekau in his bid to represent Illinois’ 6th congressional district knowing that he will support our law enforcement, fight for our veterans, get our economy back on track, and protect individual liberties."_

“I’m honored to have the endorsement. LCR represents an important part of the American family. They have worked tirelessly for common sense leadership and policies, including opposing [Joe Biden’s attempts - at the behest of the far-Left - to trample over the rights of states and parents](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=20e9fa9a6b&e=7dd0b93d07). I embrace all taxpaying, hard working people who believe in the American principles of liberty and equality, and look forward to representing all the people of IL-06 in Congress.”

I am in this fight for you. Our campaign is on behalf of all the people who want to see a return to common sense in Illinois. [Click here to make sure we win.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=d99df0230f&e=7dd0b93d07)

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_

Keith was interviewed by Chris Salcedo about Biden’s Student Loan Bailouts and Sean Casten benefitting from subsidies in Democrats’ “Don’t Say Inflation” Act.

---
| **Press Release: Can’t Have It Both Ways: Student Loan Bailouts & Left-Wing Hypocrisy**

_“The president can’t have it both ways. We can’t simultaneously have a pandemic so severe that no one needs to repay their student loans yet so mild that millions of largely unvaccinated illegal aliens can be allowed to enter our country unchecked for coronavirus.

“Aside from the clear legal issues with the president’s order, this policy is unfair and reckless on a number of levels...

“... Like creating [tax breaks for luxury car buyers](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=2b4fc90617&e=7dd0b93d07), the modern Democrat party’s elitism and detachment from the working class is on full display once again. Forgiving student loan debt disproportionately benefits those who receive graduate degrees and higher incomes. In fact, nearly a third of student loan debt is held by the top 20 percent of earners and 56 percent of student debt is held by households with graduate degrees. This bails out the wealthiest 20 percent of American households at the cost of everyone else.

“It’s precisely these types of insane leftist policies that are the real cause of inflation. Again, Democrats can’t have it both ways. They can’t claim to be for the little guy and continually use their power to benefit themselves, their political allies and the nation’s elites at the expense of the rest of the country. It’s time to send representatives to Congress who will put people over politics and end the deranged economic policies that are hurting hard working people and weakening America.”_

| **[Fox News](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=a7d2d9d594&e=7dd0b93d07): Democratic Chicago lawmaker calls out Lori Lightfoot, Kim Foxx for crime wave: 'The criminals are winning'**
Ford, who represents Chicago's West Side in the State Assembly, shared his concerns after another bloody weekend left seven dead and 23 injured... "Too many babies have been killed. Too many fathers have been killed. Too many mothers have been killed. Too many brothers have been killed. And this has to stop. And the only way you stop it is you have a system in place that's going to go after criminals," he told Caldwell.

"We cannot allow them to continue to run our communities and make our lives less safe. So only a few of them we could get them. Once we eliminate these criminals off the street, people will live in peace, and we can do it. We know where they're at."

Ford said top prosecutor Kim Foxx has a responsibility to "pull people together in the justice system" to send the message that "if you murder someone ... we will lock you up."

The lawmaker didn't hold back on his criticism of liberal Mayor Lori Lightfoot.

"The criminals are winning in Chicago. ... I think she's failed because she's lost the trust of law enforcement. She doesn't have a working relationship with Kim Foxx. She doesn't have a working relationship with [Chief Judge of the Cook County Circuit Court Timothy] Evans That's a problem. The community sees that, criminals see it, and they know that they can get away with murder."

...New York Governor Kathy Hochul issued what amounted to a mea culpa on Friday when she called it “a mistake” when the state closed down schools in favor of remote learning as COVID hit in 2020.

“We’re going to peel back every dynamic and let’s look at not just in the workplace but what happened to women when the decisions were made to have all the kids go home and learn remotely,” Hochul said in a speech to a women’s symposium in Albany. “Wow. Wow, what a mistake that was. What a mistake that was.”

“Women couldn’t go to their jobs. They lost their jobs. One child in a classroom tests positive, the whole class goes home for a week and a half. It was chaos, nothing short of chaos, and it just seems to have not ended.”

body:
“For a long time, we have told ourselves that American democracy is guaranteed, but it is not. We have to defend it. Protect it. Stand up for it.”
– President Biden
Dear Peter,
Last night, President Biden addressed the nation from Independence Hall. His message was clear: our republic is in danger. Since the 2020 election, far-right extremists have perpetuated misinformation and attempted to instill fear and mistrust in our elections. President Biden sounded the alarm, and I am reaching out to join him in doing so. This is a crisis, and we need you in this fight.
I have taken action to protect and preserve democracy in Colorado. When Tina Peters spread lies and compromised her voting equipment, I took action to stop her from further threatening the integrity of Mesa County’s elections. When election workers were threatened, I passed legislation that protects election workers and voters. We have made progress, but there is still work to be done.
Can you chip in to help me win re-election and continue fighting for democracy? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2209-q3-jg?refcode=220902-email]
Like President Biden said in his address, American Democracy is not guaranteed. It takes everyone working together to do their part to protect it. When those who believe in the Big Lie attempt to suppress and disenfranchise voters who may not agree with them, it is up to us to stand firm in the values this country was founded on. When MAGA extremists refuse to accept the outcome of a free and fair election, it is up to us to take action to preserve our democracy.
I need your help in this race, and all pro-democracy leaders need your action and support as we head into one of the most important elections of our lifetime. I have spent my first term as Secretary of State making sure Coloradans have the gold standard election system in this country, and with your help can I continue to do that. Can you step up in the name of democracy and make a contribution to my re-election campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2209-q3-jg?refcode=220902-email]
It is up to us.
Jena Griswold

| | | | [ ](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=cf486630f0&e=292fde286a)
---
| Dear Peter,

Last night in front of Independence Hall in Philadelphia, the very birthplace of our democracy and our Constitution, President Biden spoke plainly and directly to the nation about the threats posed by MAGA right-wing extremists.

**Peter — The President was right on the money: Our democracy _isn’t_ guaranteed – it requires all of us to step up and protect it from those who seek to undermine it. That’s what I’ve done as Assembly Speaker pro Tem and it’s why I’m running for Congress. [Will you chip in right now to send me to Congress to keep defending our democracy?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=b8b6e0ddc7&e=292fde286a)**

In Sacramento, I wrote the landmark _DISCLOSE Act_ , one of the nation’s toughest laws to ban dark money in our state elections. I passed the state’s first all vote-by-mail election, leading to record-breaking turnout and voter participation, and co-authored California’s groundbreaking automatic voter registration bill to make it easier for every Californian to participate in their own democracy. It’s another reason Congresswoman Jackie Speier was the first to endorse my campaign to succeed her in Congress.

**President Biden called on all of us last night to do everything we can to stop the MAGA election deniers and every one of their attempts to subvert our democratic process.** **[And I’m asking you now to pitch in whatever you can to send a proven legislator to Congress who already knows how to stand up to Trump Republicans and safeguard our democracy.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=036c175c84&e=292fde286a)**

In solidarity,
Kevin Mullin

body:
As we enter the homestretch of our campaign, we have an important question we hope you’ll answer:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=875%2E61531%2EH00uEJ)
Hello,
We wanted to reach out before the long weekend—we’ve got just under 10 weeks until November’s big election, and our top priority is growing this grassroots movement we’ve been building together. So we need to know: are you with us?
It doesn’t matter to us if you’ve been a longtime supporter of Peter or a recent addition to our coalition—we’re not taking anyone's support for granted. And as we enter the homestretch of our campaign, we have an important question we hope you’ll answer:
[**Will you add your name to publicly endorse Peter Welch for the U.S. Senate? It’s important that we show the strength and size of this grassroots movement, especially at this critical juncture in the race.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220902_p_t_endorse&t=3&akid=875%2E61531%2EH00uEJ)
[ENDORSE PETER ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220902_p_t_endorse&t=9&t=10&akid=875%2E61531%2EH00uEJ)
---
Peter and his fellow Democrats have spent the past few weeks delivering on promises to Americans, making progressive change a reality to address everything from student loan debt to climate change to prescription drug costs. All of that was made possible despite having what Peter calls a “razor’s edge Senate,” split 50/50, which means that if even one Democratic seat flips, our progressive vision basically goes kaput.
That’s why it’s never been more important to elect a progressive like Peter to the Senate. Our opponent just pulled off a major upset victory in the primaries, so we can’t afford to take anything for granted. We’ve got to do what it takes to ensure Mitch McConnell has no shot at retaking the Senate this November. How we perform in the coming days and weeks could make all the difference in this race, and we need All Hands On Deck to elect Peter and continue delivering on our progressive agenda.
[**We’ve built this movement from the ground up, and it means so much to have you on our side. Now, take your support to the next level by signing your name to Peter’s list of public endorsers. It would mean a whole lot to Peter, and to this entire team.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220902_p_t_endorse&t=4&akid=875%2E61531%2EH00uEJ)
Thanks so much,
Welch for Vermont
Now that you [**added your name**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220902_p_t_endorse&t=5&akid=875%2E61531%2EH00uEJ) to publicly endorse Peter’s campaign, how about showing your support to your neighbors and loved ones with a ‘Welch for Vermont’ yard sign? [**Make a contribution of $15 or more right away to get yours well ahead of the midterms!**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3994?t=6&akid=875%2E61531%2EH00uEJ)

This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61169122:6VJ3iVVDN:m:1:3334294963:DA1E47FB890D3B0A2D090BA405DAF467:r)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That's because**I 'M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... It's time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61169122:6VJ3iVVDN:m:1:3334294963:DA1E47FB890D3B0A2D090BA405DAF467:r)_ _**

I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.

Peter, let's not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country.** ** It's our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It's our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay.** ** And it's our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track.** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona!** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It's game time.** ** And I need you on my side.** ****_[Will you support our momentum?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61169122:6VJ3iVVDN:m:1:3334294963:DA1E47FB890D3B0A2D090BA405DAF467:r)___**

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zmdjtibk5o323ug5fh0h9p9g1rn97d4ekmiolaq8_rp22sh2s8i66or2chim6o36cth2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

Friend -

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. **

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8t4dbekce0oa65el3moq37eiam5lg3q7e8fue1g_rp22sh2s8i66or2chim1pr6cjh2bs)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

I'm not the kind of guy who asks for help, but starting a grassroots campaign is tough - **really, really tough. **

The Democrats won't stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts.

Please have my back on this one:

****[****](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl860hg4lnaic0rl17eqij6rrre1gciqifhefjug_rp22sh2s8i66or2chim1pr6cjh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $20**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlaraes3ij43k7a3uopsjsacvdph64ombq0diqt0_rp22sh2s8i66or2chim1pr6cjh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $50**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z34ob3c3s1v6uqgoprldrvq49siqp2dli0fn6c78_rp22sh2s8i66or2chim1pr6cjh2bs)

[**CONTRIBUTION OF $100**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjlda1fa21pog5rc2ircq7djathshms22tilskr8_rp22sh2s8i66or2chim1pr6cjh2bs)

Look, I'm not a politician. I'm nothing flashy or special, just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything. So, I'm opening my heart to you today in hopes you'll stand with me.

I won't give you empty promises & fancy slogans. That's not me. But I'll give you my word as a veteran that I'll fight with all I have to do what's right and make you proud.

Thank you & God bless.

| Team,

A recent NBC News poll had an interesting result when it comes to what voters are most concerned about this November. The top issue to voters? **Threats to democracy.**

And right now, the three biggest threats to democracy are on the ballot this November in Arizona. Trump’s hand-picked Arizona trio – Kari Lake, Mark Finchem and Abe Hamadeh – continue to directly threaten our democracy on the campaign trail.

**Donald Trump has willfully put our national security at risk! Documents with the highest sensitivity were stored in the basement at his _golf resort_. What was he planning to do with them?**
**[Please sign our petition! Simply put: Democrats are delivering for organized labor, and we’ll always support the backbone of Indiana’s economy. **** Join Indiana Democrats and organized labor this Saturday at Monument Circle for Labor Fest, a day to celebrate the historic achievements of Labor and its contributions to the state and nation.
