body:
Sign up to phone bank for Alexandria from home.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220902-3352-header&t=1&akid=3352%2E2526796%2E_L-9Uz)
As much as we wish she could, Alexandria can’t head back to Washington this fall without a fight. She’s facing off with a MAGA, Republican opponent in the general election this November. We’ve fought off GOP attacks before, so we know the best strategy: when they go low, we get out and organize!
Phone banking is one of the most accessible and effective ways to spread the word about successes from Alexandria’s past term, her key campaign priorities, and the upcoming 2022 election. And the best part is, you don’t have to live in NY-14 to participate! You can make calls for the campaign from anywhere.
**Our first remote phone banking event for the 2022 race is Saturday, September 3rd from 1-4 PM EDT.** If you can’t make it, no worries! We have more sessions planned for every Saturday leading up to the November election. [**Will you RSVP for just one Saturday phone bank between now and the election?**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220902-3352&utm_source=em20220902-3352&t=2&akid=3352%2E2526796%2E_L-9Uz)
Here are the event details:
---
[Remote Phone Banking for AOC](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220902-3352&utm_source=em20220902-3352&t=3&akid=3352%2E2526796%2E_L-9Uz)
Saturday, September 3 (and every Saturday through the election)
1:00 - 4:00 pm ET/ 10:00 - 1:00 PM PT
Zoom
**[Get more info or RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220902-3352&utm_source=em20220902-3352&t=4&akid=3352%2E2526796%2E_L-9Uz)** _After you RSVP, we’ll send you the Zoom link to join._
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14709?source=em20220902-3352&utm_source=em20220902-3352&t=5&akid=3352%2E2526796%2E_L-9Uz)
If you have never phone banked before, not to fear – we always start with training. Our shifts are held on Zoom, where we start by teaching our best practices for phone banking, setting up our phone banking platform, and going over our script used during calls.
Hope to see you on the dialer!
In solidarity,
Team AOC

body:
Friend,

In late August, Kristina Karamo appeared at an event hosted by Church Militant, an extremist anti-LGBTQ organization.
Honestly, I could stop you there, because that sentence says it all.

But don’t just take it from me. The Southern Poverty Law Center has labeled Church Militant a hate group – and the Catholic Church has actively denounced the organization. But that’s apparently just fine for Kristina Karamo.

Read that again, friend. Jocelyn’s opponent is associating and soliciting support from a hate group. Time and time again, Karamo shows us exactly who she is through the words she says and the people she stands with. There is no mystery here. No secret plan. She figures she can just say it all out loud.

It’s almost unbelievable she’s being this brazen. But it really does fit with the pattern of behavior. Want proof Karamo would abuse the bully pulpit of the office? Thought the “Satanists” and “traitors” comments were one-offs? Nope. They are constant themes in Karamo’s world.
This kind of hate has no room in our politics.

Add your name if you agree that Kristina Karamo must disavow any support from Church Militant and any other hate groups that might support her now. >>

subject: Still trying to catch up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
It's going to take a lot of resources to protect our majority in the House in a notoriously tough midterm election year.
#
Peter,
This year, I’ve helped pass some landmark legislation, like the Inflation Reduction Act. Our movement is building towards a future of clean, renewable energy, health care for all, stronger worker protections, and economic justice.
I’ve also been working to elect progressives and protect the Democratic majority this November. I’ve been right alongside people-first progressives running in tough Democratic primaries and Democrats running in tough swing districts against the GOP — knocking doors, running phonebanks, holding events, and much more.
It’s going to take a lot of resources to protect our majority in the House in a notoriously tough midterm election year. It’s going to take a lot of resources to help Democrats win in November against Big Lie Republicans — but my fundraising has been slipping ever since Q1 this year. **We're 12% behind pace on our strong online fundraising from earlier this year.**
[**I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t important, Peter — but I’m really relying on my supporters to help us pick up our fundraising. Can you make your first donation to my campaign today to help us get back on track?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16232?refcode=em20220902-1578&t=1&akid=1578%2E420207%2Ejoahf1)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16232?refcode=em20220902-1578&t=20&akid=1578%2E420207%2Ejoahf1)**
Election Day is less than 10 weeks away and a lot is on the line. If we elect more progressives AND hold our Democratic majority, we have the chance to build on our successes under President Biden. We would have the chance to continue legislating towards the future we want — an America for all, a country closer to achieving economic, social, racial, and environmental justice.
And we must hold our majority to protect our democracy. The right-wing GOP continues to peddle dangerous lies about the 2020 election results. It continues to attack LGBTQIA+ communities, public school teachers, activists, and the very foundations of our democracy. It’s absolutely critical that we protect the Democratic majorities in the House and Senate, and stop a GOP takeover in Congress.
I have a plan to help elect Democrats across the country. But I can only enact our full organizing and campaigning plan if we see stronger fundraising. We simply can’t have our fundraising 12% behind at this critical juncture.
[**So, Peter, can I count on your support? Make your first donation to my campaign right now and help me protect our Democratic majority, our democracy, and our future.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16232?refcode=em20220902-1578&t=21&akid=1578%2E420207%2Ejoahf1)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16232?refcode=em20220902-1578&t=22&akid=1578%2E420207%2Ejoahf1)**
Thank you for being in this fight alongside me.
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220902-1578-footer&t=23&refcode2=1578_420207_joahf1&akid=1578%2E420207%2Ejoahf1)**

But there’s a reality here we don’t talk about enough: The makeup of state legislatures can make or break a Democratic governorship. Even if Stacey and Beto win their races, they’ll only be able to get their progressive agendas off the ground with the support of state Democrats in the legislature! We have less than 70 days until the midterms, and the GOP is laser-focused on key states to hold and expand their majorities. They’re pouring millions of dollars into races across the country, but we’re not backing down – and we need you with us. Folks, we’re expecting a huge fundraising slowdown over the
holiday weekend, so I wanted to reach out before you log off. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20622?t=1008&amount=4&akid=5317%2E3611125%2Ew02AHg ]If you
can, will you chip in $4 to my campaign? Here are 4 reasons why:

1. Polls have me and JD Vance neck-and-neck. We need resources early in
the month to close the gap and stay ahead.

2. Ohio’s open Senate seat will decide Senate control. Our race is one of
Democrats’ best chances at flipping a seat this year.

3. There’s a whole lot on the line. A 50/50 Senate has failed to protect
abortion, expand healthcare access, end the filibuster, and cut workers in
on the deal.

4. JD Vance and his far-right billionaire backers are upping their
attacks. They’ve got money to burn and they’re spending MILLIONS to keep
Ohio red.

We’ve got a lot to accomplish between now and Election Day—but we’re still
in a bit of a summer fundraising slump. [ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20622?t=1009&amount=4&akid=5317%2E3611125%2Ew02AHg ]We’ll need to pick up the pace
if we’re going to compete with the big money boosting JD Vance. Can I
count on you to chip in $4 before you peace out?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

Happy Friday, Friend.

I hope everyone had a chance to see Biden's speech last night. If not, do it. It is past time that we, as a nation, take a strong stand against the anti-democratic political extremism of the right. Trump and his MAGA followers do not represent every Republican, but they are the dominant force in the GOP today. The MAGA movement will not "fade away" if we just ignore it. We are facing the rise of a fascist movement in this country, fueled by lies, that intends to lock in its minority political views through gerrymandering and court-packing. We have seen a roll-back of rights before -- during Reconstruction, when southern whites used violence and a twisted justice system to oppress black Americans. White northerners let it happen. We cannot let complacency undermine democracy again. Biden is correct to call this a "battle for the soul of our nation." On the pro-democracy side, we have a big tent ranging from progressives like AOC to principled conservatives like Liz Cheney. On the MAGA side. we have a horde of Trump-flag-wavers who spout inane cheers like "Let's Go Brandon." Their arguments are illogical and tired ("but her emails!" A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” | | | This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f7ae0a1748ca446da328c145d8bdfb67&_e=HNjF3KwSx8olSeAabjHIx_CpEXwlRa2yts0TSpTK-O1zzVWLuX89ww9lxt2pHFmoS82oS3RAPTPun1aeMmVqZOO4R-NnO_qKfOIuFfilo5Zg3y8A9M-HTG3t1DES805iWkM-hNt-qdCUcLQ3qJ8CT0ktAXApMPPw-HeIUOjK8EeNM2E2bPxz4qEElTNUFjg5rz64bliur6mLWJqC4polcg9aIEHBx579X099zqKjG3RM4e74_wJqIOM0ce3SLEMAV049mS1CewTJYTh2Y-f4BL86XB9sf_PUGgrSIyKG6YiZIkVLIZFTEFIrKfSx-9m8VDrdep6TSEUlpCItRxrDCTRav-kb4U5rDtolakqPzq6yXGXN7RFm3-Q0fsY71LQVaYj2YH-w7953GTRIX65I_g3LdTIvPlzwsyMN_eBJyJE%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f7ae0a1748ca446da328c145d8bdfb67&_e=HNjF3KwSx8olSeAabjHIx_CpEXwlRa2yts0TSpTK-O1zzVWLuX89ww9lxt2pHFmoS82oS3RAPTPun1aeMmVqZOO4R-NnO_qKfOIuFfilo5Zg3y8A9M-HTG3t1DES805iWkM-hNt-qdCUcLQ3qJ8CT0ktAXApMPPw-HeIUOjK8EeNM2E2bPxz4qEElTNUFjg5rz64bliur6mLWJqC4polcg9aIEHBx579X099zqKjG3RM4e74_wJqIOM0ce3SLEMAqh3VJYZH7Ewpm2PnxiSDoYsoa-ExGb8WefDipC2PCEPiaIGJW9nwF96FFVxU8X4KDUfaKiMnsx8PxXkKmTYxWKL7P_jbX0FP2InFTU9zTPBLUyuEiicmnkbgSZPdMm5ZaRhwmiP2Y0DrX2MoVJsCgyGkOeFAF6zyHMihdjqJoEA%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f7ae0a1748ca446da328c145d8bdfb67&_e=HNjF3KwSx8olSeAabjHIx_CpEXwlRa2yts0TSpTK-O1zzVWLuX89ww9lxt2pHFmoS82oS3RAPTPun1aeMmVqZOO4R-NnO_qKfOIuFfilo5Zg3y8A9M-HTG3t1DES805iWkM-hNt-qdCUcLQ3qJ8CT0ktAXApMPPw-HeIUOjK8EeNM2E2bPxz4qEElTNUFjg5rz64bliur6mLWJqC4polcg9aIEHBx579X099zqKjG3RM4e74_wJqIOM0ce3SLEMAj2G1GOnh-bnJMVWrDHHtArl67uajUvwerJULzcupEw4WYOUuXXVU1X26U4jKJC8Iurp8aqmWuCdeeycWiEo8nOjOerk-MdBKsuJIOaWdsagDt6X6JZ25S5MrYTU3K59r7vs_sF4ZyZGwT5zGwopZa_1N63yZ70LpSbHLgZMHObA%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**I've spent 10 years leading Turning Point USA, the _BIGGEST_ and most _IMPACTFUL_ pro-America student organization with 500,000+ student activists in all 50 states.** And at Turning Point USA, I've met THOUSANDS of college students from every corner of the country -- and I've criss-crossed America to speak at HUNDREDS of colleges and universities. * my 10-point case that exposes higher education -- so YOU can be the judge

**_And I want you to know -- this isn't just another book about Campus Leftists_.** Instead, it combines FRONTLINE EXPERIENCE from my 10 years criss-crossing America to speak with students ... | | **Footing The Bill For Harvard Graduates 😡**
---
| |
---
Last week moochers, Harvard grads, and well-off elites...(ahem, I mean _helpless_ _graduates_) got a hefty gift from the Biden administration in the form of student loan forgiveness. The cost? A cool [$1 trillion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MLVMcZBPBa-1e6UwFjbjPt3DcwvP34NrAn-ffEutV01YyRa3J7KCG4YN5q2C2caiGyIuCo5OfHUx4nWBNPl9HqIlmb8OWb3TFSZfqDwVN_hTZMfn0cc79v8SJfjch3WsEH-EHZF1BcJlOrHyRY7tXqIO2XE0yEGBUt7fK0wQU-sVxHm9wIBqj2DFASUNf96Pleue-r6KO7Yb5oWLAtxgYlurULolAcp5M6gVr6ODMdwZvgJUEevzmPfpDfQLqEXLaWnqH2wqC-AGynEBCTQGnH3_B5ve_zK3G2ZVlX85cGkmo7se1B62OZCyybP7v027pw%3D%3D) over the next decade. While liberals [boast](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MPbh2Dzhbb_Ho7nJZha7_kqUX8SxG8bElZE2bME3PVtdpp-0DtGN0kxT3d1Kd2iCUf_GDTd0jrlN07duAVwZ0dVb_uNxyq_iGUDAG_HAeV-jY78P_eatoRdHIulUmpvOS8gdzLNA-yNlrxXnEYoIuk6tNsj9OzGzRxf0delnIkQOb-oxgha6CpDav7r46DTZqoQE_ot69AwzmIz0FAKWMNImMSN7lPzmU5vjY39fsen7) about their “win,” I want to remind them that Biden’s student loan bailout will only _worsen_ our record-breaking inflation and _raise_ college tuition. Take it from one of Obama’s chief economic advisors. Jason Furman, who chaired Obama’s Council of Economic Advisers, made a good point when [he said](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MIFiKf2z9Et0adBSv7klnPYNvFuqscnJShiwJxi87Qv68OwT63xvQMk6nJYApP8uAgbNKtOcRvoOwnwQH70Pr8Q-TI3plrmT-FA5ppwxyUXXV5gSOqeRK-2sfWpwLvzVFEOFnAWlKjBlxmuBtMzfYt1pBL5A3778X3Q_vPWoGfqkD_jKn9MKgUBHmC7qhmlN3WGobFBH1Pu3dLhfqfGO7ibS2zpYqilMXlBSSBOfS83V8L6Mh2uLHHIJjqqapbKTMdpRDi1ZMoqFAmuPrHUTA4l5mHvk_g8hP9YvNToNaFfN), “ _pouring roughly half [a] trillion dollars of gasoline on the inflationary fire that is already burning_ _is reckless_.” Speaking of fueling the fire, canceling student debt encourages big universities to keep [increasing tuition](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MKPjR_RlqEoS0Mnx0aYpTz1JS4hv7yQmAbZTX_NebdyLH4COTnRb7PhA-X6GM6oHpU0YqM8dspDwgBkt1qdNsa3LqdfwD6cNxRdjc5cVmT6b9ceBIVFHYYPPvZhG1tSeC5KqBqJVgxaWH4TpyZHdFbRUbP6inagumaWN_nwQA7aGeGukQYTwel84ziZmWx6qzen109FepwRXhWz06J402yi4q-oS9FzxmDyfa_DM9NiY81IeoMHS6Usv2Vmwsn9299S42ocBegI9c_FZsi_l4OlTwHQZc5ZCNLUbHgeI8P4w) because they know the government will bail out students. Not to mention, if the liberals had their way and all loan debt was canceled, debt would return to today’s levels in just [15 years](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MBa3nPDh4PAQ6YF1SSkT0YOvzHzjyABBryww-rN5MeXB7AaGCJxFDk8fGw6Bx6fwUZY6ApWhHzB0TN9TPhta7VKkmXQWgz7L59OFCRo8ltKwxu9WFXn8BTjBk_F_KX8z2S3Jv_H3IYFnNuLh8SZ36WpNjVK-t7-p6XXcg6CNnYLgENWKCsEThs4_idBRHTxzc1KBFuDmrgtuDJaqz4jWMOlcBf_uTJ-7bh1SJiVzQDlTIEnYDk1uU8QJVbb4o4WTwg%3D%3D). Economics aside, this bailout is simply unfair. It is unfair to force non-college goers and people who already paid off their debt to [foot the bill](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MEdxY2oBOi9IMjAuC2_KHAfyG4rxYSysSqmu-FX5niIXmTm7227C2xs_PIJzryB02ibLQai0TUiVc0lCycVqC4AZ_noUCmTLhqpbcfrXGAg5FGv1WcgqKskh49g2Lg2I4lI-W-aDyO3KvT48X92gOIbxm0TbHkhWlqjr4f9AWiMhB0pRkcZ2kGgUXZdV5ueQjD9Ctp5oOPyxBjKYs4Z2rEfsQibn_Rt3JRyQdug2qWpv4rTCfZ0B-l1J7HYGHOn-s6DuJXb8--tatnyfSD3DzRE%3D) for other people’s pricey education choices—many of whom [don’t need the help](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MEdxY2oBOi9IMjAuC2_KHAcyqOa4tIbkfYptv_3IAWsWV5AXOwxQumJ2eUmEIepeVhrOqtg89cx-yyAvtt6JOkbGPNq2MqmZCWgdzNlIT9n3UuHOfNLEwetZwL_FC7xjfe11btgoM9xRqNF8usiEGw5KBbEsoiW9QjaInrkE1qnWNJJJM0i34NUJToQWgMjC9DqFsK0dIEYsu0nK6huFsesp0B22gLKmeJS_pEYs2dQzqQdWmjBZfmIDS5xHHSkf7hk7_ZEm9YPne53K3AXtZjUikkapwUAEG8OhVp1nF9m-). A boneheaded decision like this is a blatant buy for votes, and the Democrats are willing to rob the working and middle class to do it.

Hannah Lawson, who was diagnosed with brain cancer when she was 7, is [returning to work](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MFocrWQr2N47QajwIpr1xQc-DWmDNIluq_iNRXECwnhK9arZXqFA3c-XvKRGSoX-qFpxSgNpi69b2r1j3H2cCiuBD6tH1ZZ0OftN-TSAHS_c9PrKHk0xq85AQOuigP1P_Ip8J6QXXrAOccn7TaAGDdMRAxVx75t-euZxVneJgbDIlBdBn3ghkwDUzyhD5-Ih2C5gMlTMQD42CXIXlmUvEHSNQZbkZ_iSTDuwElImDiItQMjkwrwEo8eOyIWLD44JLKb1Ro5-bBnXecZJ3DrCrSsiA3mnzhK3xQ-Yc1e1GcRa6HQ08zWRkeJ2Qe7PXcmN0E9-dmTFuKDo3xgW8Ej7_nFBTRm5kmxXEBHzZMe5Utae) at the East Tennessee Children's Hospital where she was a patient nearly 15 years ago. This local hero's journey not only led her to create Hannah's Army Angels, which raises money for the Pediatric Brain Tumor Foundation and collects supplies to send to soldiers serving overseas, it also influenced her to become a nurse dealing directly with pediatric oncology (on the exact same floor she was treated on!). This inspiring full-circle story particularly warms my heart because my daughter Isabel [just came home](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=2a619352184f402cae8d6bda71c80f1e&_e=RkVuyIgNIR4ivFHTETW8MCWbvxfU7p5ja6uIiYlAwCIjXLmts0xPzE1ZGYWQl_u7-68OzYEDo59tG5shQrDqK_4K4Cpry5Go-dsEA4baaJugpsR6OzJaD6KNd27abQlAZn1-K4asiJZRIJs6EEz0wnpV7pJWBFLUH4A_UhCUZbrGoJbX78VrrPLDC-rOT5bYQBKZ1Msu0gacyVfA5hKcUMm0KZf48YDHxNk01XijV8fza7xolTF3u94BO82XUB5E) from the East Tennessee Children's Hospital, where we were given 16 days of excellent care. Nurses like Hannah should be thanked from the rooftops.

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | | | | Footing The Bill For Harvard Graduates 😡 | | Last week moochers, Harvard grads, and well-off elites...(ahem, I mean helpless graduates) got a hefty gift from the Biden administration in the form of student loan forgiveness. The cost? A cool over the next decade. While liberals about their “win,” I want to remind them that Biden’s student loan bailout will only worsen our record-breaking inflation and raise college tuition. Take it from one of Obama’s chief economic advisors. Jason Furman, who chaired Obama’s Council of Economic Advisers, made a good point when , “ pouring roughly half [a] trillion dollars of gasoline on the inflationary fire that is already burning is reckless.” Speaking of fueling the fire, canceling student debt encourages big universities to keep because they know the government will bail out students. Not to mention, if the liberals had their way and all loan debt was canceled, debt would return to today’s levels in just . Economics aside, this bailout is simply unfair. It is unfair to force non-college goers and people who already paid off their debt to for other people’s pricey education choices—many of whom -. A boneheaded decision like this is a blatant buy for votes, and the Democrats are willing to rob the working and middle class to do it. | | | | | Coming Full Circle 💕 | | Hannah Lawson, who was diagnosed with brain cancer when she was 7, is at the East Tennessee Children's Hospital where she was a patient nearly 15 years ago. This local hero's journey not only led her to create Hannah's Army Angels, which raises money for the Pediatric Brain Tumor Foundation and collects supplies to send to soldiers serving overseas, it also influenced her to become a nurse dealing directly with pediatric oncology (on the exact same floor she was treated on!). This inspiring full-circle story particularly warms my heart because my daughter Isabel from the East Tennessee Children's Hospital, where we were given 16 days of excellent care. This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3cd99c32f61846ce93cf00a5dbf1c1e9&_e=bzY8t93xzWuW-lzS7xS26llJE3oux9f9Rh5nVDigaKan-j1-Nf3JO_iY3PFqo5ti5N0wIFsvm-53aWO_l39iG4or6rVcWqLHoT-87oJygPsZmnO_-Qp3DysTbRuwxzlwACHtrersEEqlxWSNVkkWnP1Vg_zuh5mVxw8SfR8a5enwTnm_XazByyPz0qDwpfRRtXgR3syn04L82XVtPgLv2dCEoJB6vCM4oRRiQMVbTyCSfl1Rcl3fx-ukLZU06oEU2-zN2JyMRNnGX38oheQsiZzj3KzMEZlxz0SyhvktjeVYRNGBjSEo7lbUhDNJfF2LvDS67HPd7wi1YiDtw0XN3T-lTRNiATRCW_li23mIPpbj6ujIUFD0uE3CWyV-ctomqQDdc4OVhCsEczmRaRWqpQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. America is at a crossroads

https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/bidens-speech?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=4fe0ee89ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-4fe0ee89ea-617881201
Fellow Patriot,
While Biden stated that we are the true heirs of this experiment in democracy, he accused those not sharing his political disposition as being a threat to this country.

This is the voice of evil at its root, and such words uttered by an American President beckon us to consider our national identity in these perilous times.

We have lost our moral compass and footing if we do not do everything in our power as voting Americans to take a stand against those who herald a specific political ideology as the only one worthy for participation in our Constitutional Republic.
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/bidens-speech?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=4fe0ee89ea-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-4fe0ee89ea-617881201
In the place of our traditional Judeo-Christian foundation as a nation, the Radical Left agenda has defiled the throne of government power.

>From that desecrated throne, such are deemed righteous: young men competing as females, child sex traffickers taking advantage of open borders, and hardworking taxpayers funding an agenda they have no say in and can do nothing about.

Enough is enough!

| | | | | Peter _**,**_ **Last night President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for.** [**Can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a40d185-1851-4b9d-b069-d1fd36bb5335/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _He called out Republicans who call Democrats names like it's a bodily function, but have been whining since the moment he referred to MAGA Republicans as "semi-fascist." ---
**September 2, 2022** Friend – Election season is in full swing! We’re more ready than ever to send Ron Johnson back to Washington, retire Tony Evers, and fire Josh Kaul! We still need as much help as we can get to win this November. If you’re able to volunteer, join us on our website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VsLgeNFrtuHusRivV19v3aCXxtdEYxug7BpyM8N6AZw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=2). \- Team WisGOP | Earlier this week, the[ Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reached a new low](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=ez1BnRg01gPGR4qyG5PO2LV_3pMbUHIlFBrsZcCPouMY56iXwJLM5qB_PC47au0b8tbnc8PT5SVrjXZYYriDOBIg4x9mcjCziuT1gm81_7LuF9WUmMNXkQgMWVIkwDbtrIWj1eoZlQF_F-Yjy1KY22c0Srg586yfh8Ab115lTYT-SGzRSq7gzH1gOle3zxKu2mnRnF5QZXppbUKFp_pCR8HJVkzW9Yje_sidGOrfkK8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=3) in their reporting when they attacked Tim Michels for charitable contributions he and his wife, Barbara, have made in recent years. What were these controversial contributions? It included gifts to pro-life organizations, Catholic nuns, some of the largest churches in Wisconsin, and even cancer research firms. [Tim hit back](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=-5TkjH9ekU4a52tmVarpAO73nU-N9IwqbK-KSlKiP9Bma3wr4yPqu7KTrRHBIUlKD5rDAtOrBGmB34T-_mMlZyZoTGD6_kJEVMIPYS76dc21ztkPzzuMnnVsSH6c-UlV&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=4), slamming the Journal Sentinel for their anti-Christian reporting and their Democratic bias, as they continue to carry water for Tony Evers’ failing Administration. On Thursday night, Joe Biden gave a dark and divisive speech in front of a red-lit Independence Hall in Philadelphia. This on the eve of the Labor Day holiday weekend, when he will travel to be in Milwaukee for Laborfest on Monday. In the speech, Biden slammed Republicans, calling us a “threat to this country,” “an extremism that threatens the basic foundations of our republic,” and saying we “do not respect the Constitution...[or] believe in the rule of law.” This speech highlighted that [Joe Biden is more focused on dividing Americans](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0XVHBPh-0Q3G8OaTQ-w4SjcoZtbM2niA5PegSvXPdxQeEjI_O10zrh1ZQrBalsDPcUlbyqYUsKblsFeKlYodeT8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=5) than bringing us together. It is a disgrace, and we will make sure to tell him as much when he arrives in Wisconsin next week. | | This week, the RPW, RNC, and NRSC [sent a demand letter to the Wisconsin Elections Commission](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0TySCupAHqLU_Dj35DR9ae4XEA3JSL9AHj1kRbs_UeSSCm1366C0OxE-LBOj02_IPw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=6) insisting that they close the massive security loopholes on the myvote.wi.gov website. As was exposed in recent weeks, there is currently nothing preventing a nefarious actor from requesting and having absentee ballots sent to any address, for any voter in our state. WEC must immediately change this function and only allow voters to request absentee ballots be sent to their registered address on file. Without a change in this policy, the opportunity exists for anyone to request an absentee ballot to be sent anywhere in the country, and will lead to continued questions surrounding the integrity of our elections. The RNC Election Integrity Team and RPW will keep you up-to-date as any further developments occur.
---|---|---
* * *
**In Case You Missed It...**
[**Then And Now: Tony Evers’ Words on Kenosha**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0bBDEJcAOIwrM6_WSyfHeAceNh7y3Oftq2oDkwrrnIp4eEDcDHCatLzVSxyu4skAog&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=7)****
Two years ago, Tony Evers fanned the flames of violence in Kenosha – resulting in mass rioting, looting, and destruction to the community. Then and now, Tony Evers has inflamed tensions, vilified law enforcement, and refused to acknowledge that his inaction caused the city to burn.
[**Barnes Supports Biden’s Plan to Cancel Student Debt**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0Z9BO-vlDSyCZ1doSgC19e9M2KpgXQNfpRYcH0DD8CvIg-CbidDx6r-nGRw7IsBb1I-22xHz9y65vpH4Ypjik9Q&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=8)****
While battleground Democrats across the nation are critical of President Biden’s plan to [cancel up to $20,000](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=OhlATZ-QoebODN39iuw6LrnjRsQjvhbTWmA4IyWYGcLsEONLxXH6UyzseayhdPMGCkC962cGLbeJnnj9VkcSJTf02j6oaU0B3rzZ9C8UR0aDvV5PErmP_8VIskzpNr7_Ez7WHSyqbZzx5QuE81IVGg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=9) in student debt, Lieutenant Governor Barnes is in full support. His campaign [recently stated](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=OhlATZ-QoebODN39iuw6LrnjRsQjvhbTWmA4IyWYGcIBSqey5qRQ2TRxeH5mEVOaF2DvzZAJ-ZyudRkgT2AIq-LhGcqSvoFt_CiFLqcov308jIfFKl1RwnZoinS459aqfS4ZwN5DEAskRvyQEm3TUw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=10) that Biden’s plan will “help Wisconsinites” – [two-thirds](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=OhlATZ-QoebODN39iuw6LrnjRsQjvhbTWmA4IyWYGcIDrqQpT0BqJgBrdo2Eyyqg6HuzNIV74aL5EkdfKMFgd7aPJOevuQEVmMm6-dvxsVM_FMAW9m8n0udPZxse_MoFTpoHUa_jpXHhCBJ6HTczSQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=11) of whom do not have college degrees.
[**Barnes Garners Support from Radical Socialist Groups**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0XTI0WXUT5Ke-RqU5eG7d5deunYY0BRhRVAhk8N_m9_60glUWjg5FHWbGqdUgee389VFzdPiuOLbp9LQcxTub28&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=12)****
Barnes has garnered endorsements from several advocacy groups who support the most radical and far-left ideas. The Working Families Party, People’s Action, and Color of Change all signaled their support for Barnes, showing his true liberal values no matter how hard he might try to pass as a moderate. On top of that, he already received endorsements from some of the most liberal members of Congress like AOC, Bernie Sanders, and Elizabeth Warren.
[**ICYMI: What They Said About the Journal Sentinel Hit Piece on Tim Michels**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0a1qcVDr0KAYjNXRDpDDWlbZlpO3sWNPrlLAcOTlan_s5H9RWTo1U8loKpLJeR5rcMa49samMLSQxLaq4dZ3UqheR0Baxqiu_MLzFXVBj_OI&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_02_newsletter_v1&n=13)****
The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel and USA Today Network-Wisconsin hit a new low this week. In an effort to smear Tim Michels, they attacked him for his charitable contributions to various organizations. Among these organizations are local churches, Catholic nuns, pregnancy resource centers, and a professorship for cancer research.
Tim Michels is an honorable candidate who will beat Tony Evers, so it comes as no surprise that the media is looking for something – anything – to smear him. Unapologetic for his faith, Tim Michels responded to this religious persecution head-on.

body:
Dear Fellow Conservative,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.”

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

[**Help Republicans retake Congress
and save America. ⇒**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=60e5325cc1004e58a63b3dff00514a08&_e=cA5514o0yAd-zOrVgbmosxIdEoz9OeK6CjlC9-qIbv5AjWq93jw7wSWGC02BBfh6m8SQ11Lo0hgXGz_CQf972wuDPBRNV9T0iQfO0wBfF9G5QaY5BYdDakv5ZDbUK-f1LpNrhK7m94OTgHMOmI9UMqOMNA7AzsMoe8y76jnIxTv-oENSCzULjICXuRweZTdp62YD63z8g8X01seqibUZ3q-nLWc7FhJvYbquvrWYaxVVw90xfvAytFhkkyWeotGQS9vZ1BJoVwf1Me_IrAQUSXNF6DYozGRT9Q2MZdwxRGrQAf5TaLOADzXhtkyPn3ZEUBoZtEhsvWTeLlRzLOCmFdEk3IFRr9_Z0zb1zcQrFqK1G3k6KnmN6e1uWnHIzg5Yez41YMRBrzWgj7qgR3-cXaP7Vpa8VPFs0NCCc8KjwKYS26DEnq5UDtCGqYK-LESrjzVweD5ZRfoX292Z7GUsmw%3D%3D)
It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[**Will you help us win back
our Republican majority? ⇒**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=60e5325cc1004e58a63b3dff00514a08&_e=cA5514o0yAd-zOrVgbmosxIdEoz9OeK6CjlC9-qIbv5AjWq93jw7wSWGC02BBfh6m8SQ11Lo0hgXGz_CQf972wuDPBRNV9T0iQfO0wBfF9G5QaY5BYdDakv5ZDbUK-f1LpNrhK7m94OTgHMOmI9UMqOMNA7AzsMoe8y76jnIxTv-oENSCzULjICXuRweZTdp62YD63z8g8X01seqibUZ3q-nLWc7FhJvYbquvrWYaxVVw90xfvAytFhkkyWeotGQS9vZ1BJoVwf1Me_IrAQUSXNF6DYozGRT9Q2MZdwxRGrQAf5TaLOADzXhtkyPn3ZE4AdBViyFEw2jWXd7OWDGZFY9mnFZPEkaLK_LLu1FgyG0MuToCLjGtZbjRYGb2j4n_k1yJZgbYtydqrREnjetS_6gtJ_CYT0UFij1PXTzfgkUmSjk07aVU7Lgh0mYR8JVzCzUvDGmryoM1NhEzvrw3g%3D%3D)
We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?
